body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1176%2E135344%2EB0j3nQ)

Friends,
Here’s a headline from this weekend that caught my eye:
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-feb24.z4X5uQ&refcode=em240227-2-15&t=2&akid=1176%2E135344%2EB0j3nQ)
Here’s my rule of thumb when it comes to evaluating politicians: Look at their record, not what they say when they’re trying to get elected.
And when it comes to issues like abortion or IVF, Republican politicians know their positions are deeply unpopular, so they’re scrambling to distance themselves from their records.
That’s true in our race—all of the serious Republican candidates have a history of extremist positions on choice of any kind, and, if they win, they’d likely have the opportunity to vote on issues like abortion and IVF.
While the Michigan Senate primary isn’t until August (even though the presidential primary is today!), let’s review the bidding on where each of our Republican opponents stand on this issue:
* Former Congressman Mike Rogers repeatedly voted for an abortion ban even in the cases of rape, incest, and miscarriage, and co-authored 4 bills that would have banned the destruction of frozen IVF embryos
* Former Congressman Peter Meijer has campaigned on being “100% pro-life” even in cases of rape or incest, supported a federal ban on abortion, and co-sponsored a bill that would have prevented the disposal of frozen IVF embryos
* Businessman Sandy Pensler says he is “a pro-life conservative;” called Roe v. Wade a “terrible decision,” and claimed that Prop 3 in Michigan, which protected the right to choose in Michigan’s Constitution, “went too far.”

So yes, if Republicans win control of the Senate, keep the House, and elect Donald Trump, a federal abortion ban that affects Michiganders is absolutely realistic.
**[The path to the White House and control of the Senate runs through Michigan. We know Michiganders are with us on these issues, so we’re working to hold our opponents accountable to their voting histories. Will you help us set the record straight?](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-feb24.z4X5uQ&refcode=em240227-2-15&t=3&akid=1176%2E135344%2EB0j3nQ)**

clean_body: Friends, Here’s a headline from this weekend that caught my eye: Here’s my rule of thumb when it comes to evaluating politicians: Look at their record, not what they say when they’re trying to get elected. And when it comes to issues like abortion or IVF, Republican politicians know their positions are deeply unpopular, so they’re scrambling to distance themselves from their records. That’s true in our race—all of the serious Republican candidates have a history of extremist positions on choice of any kind, and, if they win, they’d likely have the opportunity to vote on issues like abortion and IVF. While the Michigan Senate primary isn’t until August (even though the presidential primary is today!), let’s review the bidding on where each of our Republican opponents stand on this issue: Former Congressman Mike Rogers repeatedly voted for an abortion ban even in the cases of rape, incest, and miscarriage, and co-authored 4 bills that would have banned the destruction of frozen IVF embryos Former Congressman Peter Meijer has campaigned on being “100% pro-life” even in cases of rape or incest, supported a federal ban on abortion, and co-sponsored a bill that would have prevented the disposal of frozen IVF embryos Businessman Sandy Pensler says he is “a pro-life conservative;” called Roe v. Wade a “terrible decision,” and claimed that Prop 3 in Michigan, which protected the right to choose in Michigan’s Constitution, “went too far.” So yes, if Republicans win control of the Senate, keep the House, and elect Donald Trump, a federal abortion ban that affects Michiganders is absolutely realistic. Fellow Conservative,

Some say that our district should be safe for Republicans in November, but with almost half the district as “new territory,” we are not taking any chances. **The way people lose is to forget who they are, where they come from and who they represent.** I’ve seen former colleagues make this mistake before; I made a vow to myself to never become complacent.

name: Replace Sinema
subject: Sinema betrayed women
body:
Abortion rights, IVF, and even birth control are in peril because of Sinema | | | Peter – Kyrsten Sinema had the choice to either stand up for Arizona women’s right to make decisions about their own bodies and codify Roe v. Wade – or to side with Republican politicians’ “right” to filibuster. **She chose to side with the Republicans.** **Now, women, pro-abortion advocates, and doctors across the country are left to fight tooth and nail to protect reproductive healthcare:** [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsXrQUgb5Mxwrt8WkjElmEmugKGZ5xm77nXX3oOXt5LmJ60BPQGzujKkO2FyzkJr3cCBeHDtyvMansySYuhxvrWZMXnFlDa2OT0C1Vbis2wgz4vCpA_zcxGFFI30aQ-jopPeo0-wQQbqUKdIuj8CJVwXaEAhc-Y_tzBoY30BLjaa0oA4pBFCG6Bzt3K6gjr8Uazh3LWmgC8BkkLHvmCNoAx4tz0IyGAUdC-wYSpFKzNWVUs2G4O9FuGgQK6QvthdGy0Xi3n3X-GQqFAzdgHL3MdVPTMgN9ogIOZSSo_JAO2mp-Dh24FmYgxjEzmO0zPEzg/448/SYIg2LN8Q8y5R1SUsD6t9w/h0/h001.GJJb3_X_vmxt3PnrZ6ptJ9yGmvqooyrkBdANt2pgv_o) **Make no mistake: if MAGA Republican Kari Lake gets a hold of Arizona’s Senate seat, this doctor’s story could only be the beginning of an even darker time. | **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. clean_body: A Marine Corps veteran, conservative fighter, and Mayor of a major city, Kevin Lincoln is the Republican we need in Washington. | | I want to be clear, Fellow patriot. Nothing has changed: Kevin Lincoln still has our support, and his race in CA-9 is still a TOP PRIORITY for House GOP leadership. A true conservative fighter, Marine Corps veteran, and Mayor of a major California city, Kevin is precisely the kind of leader we need in Washington and the future the GOP needs. That’s why it was a no-brainer to endorse his campaign and why it should be a no-brainer for you to back him. Kevin will help get our country back on track. He has already proven he can win in a blue state and effectively deliver conservative solutions after victory. He is EXACTLY what we need in Washington. Kevin has what it takes to flip this TOP PRIORITY seat, and we need your help to lay the foundation for his campaign. Thank you, Rep. Elise Stefanik House GOP Conference Chair | Meet Kevin Lincoln My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran. Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. Earlier tonight, Attorney General Eric Holder made a big announcement, and we wanted you to be among the first to know: **The NDRC and affiliates are launching a 10 Year Plan to fight gerrymandering and create fair maps across the country.** AG Holder put it best: The NDRC was made for this moment. Since our founding in 2017, the NDRC and our affiliates have helped establish what _The New York Times_ described in 2022 as the fairest national congressional map in 40 years. And in the past few months, we’ve seen fairer maps established in even more places, like Wisconsin, Alabama, and Louisiana. But our progress is constantly challenged, alongside new, brazen attempts to gerrymander — there is simply no “off season” in redistricting. I want to tell you exactly what we plan to achieve in the decade ahead. Because one thing is for certain: **We can’t do it without _you_.** [**If you’re with us, add your name to say you’re ready to fight for fair redistricting for the long haul >>**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79876255/457781396/1899600233?oUiLN4AP1DkjshlkFJEdk74SHygvTAqFplE56ESWsUpKAu83ZZYGxQNwjuICyv/JrK/GH9pHcDd9ie0Q+OUzkHIRTHqNExYXWeu9BytYgck=&refcode=EM_20240227_FR_12X_expansion922_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImYyNGJjZTI3LWRmZDUtZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6OiMueMhFDeJm6f3luybPNq-HBNLN65r7dRbZtMXVN4=&emci=f68a4bc3-bdd5-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=f24bce27-dfd5-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=8431045) [COUNT ME IN](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79876256/457781397/1899600233?oUiLN4AP1DkjshlkFJEdk74SHygvTAqFplE56ESWsUpKAu83ZZYGxQNwjuICyv/JrK/GH9pHcDd9ie0Q+OUzkHIRTHqNExYXWeu9BytYgck=&refcode=EM_20240227_FR_12X_expansion922_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImYyNGJjZTI3LWRmZDUtZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6OiMueMhFDeJm6f3luybPNq-HBNLN65r7dRbZtMXVN4=&emci=f68a4bc3-bdd5-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=f24bce27-dfd5-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=8431045) Fighting for fair and representative maps is a crucial part of the fight to protect and enhance our democracy — and it goes _well beyond_ one election cycle. (New, fairer maps were just finalized in Louisiana last month!) Now, playing the long-game doesn’t mean quietly going to the side and only showing back up at opportune moments. Instead, we’ve got to be actively engaged at all stages of the process. That’s why we’ve broken our plan into five parts:
* Developing state-of-the-art mapping capabilities: Technology and the use of AI are changing rapidly, and our investments in best-in-class mapping tools will ensure that we are always on the cutting edge, giving us a leg up in ensuring future maps are fairer than ever before.
* Shifting and building power in the states: The NDRC will build power so that we can shift power, investing in Democracy Defenders who are aligned with our mission in states across the country. Let’s ensure voters can choose their politicians, and not the other way around.
* Prioritizing grassroots mobilization and public education: We will mobilize supporters like you to get involved in efforts on the ground where they matter most, from fair redistricting to a fair and accurate 2030 Census.
* Pushing accountability efforts against bad maps and the corruption of redistricting processes: The NDRC and its affiliates will move the needle toward representative democracy by holding legislators accountable to their voters. That means playing defense to protect good process and fair maps, while going on offense to enforce the Voting Rights Act and challenge racial and partisan gerrymanders.
* Advancing redistricting reforms and policy changes at both the state and the federal level: We are already shaping improved redistricting processes in states that faltered during this past redistricting cycle, and we’re not stopping now.

**None of this work will lead to victories overnight or even all at once. Most days, it’ll feel like we’re playing whack-a-mole while running a marathon. But together, I know we can get far fairer maps in 2032.** **This plan is all about the long haul, and we need to know who’s committed to this fight alongside us.****[Are you in? Add your name to say you’ll be a part of this 10 Year Plan.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79876257/457781398/-560123465?oUiLN4AP1DkjshlkFJEdk74SHygvTAqFplE56ESWsUpKAu83ZZYGxQNwjuICyv/JrK/GH9pHcDd9ie0Q+OUzkHIRTHqNExYXWeu9BytYgck=&refcode=EM_20240227_FR_12X_expansion922_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImYyNGJjZTI3LWRmZDUtZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6OiMueMhFDeJm6f3luybPNq-HBNLN65r7dRbZtMXVN4=&emci=f68a4bc3-bdd5-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=f24bce27-dfd5-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=8431045)** We’ll have more soon about the best way to get involved in this work and keep up our momentum. For now, thank you! Marina Marina Jenkins

clean_body: Add your name to recommit to the fight for fair redistricting >> | Earlier tonight, Attorney General Eric Holder made a big announcement, and we wanted you to be among the first to know: The NDRC and affiliates are launching a 10 Year Plan to fight gerrymandering and create fair maps across the country. AG Holder put it best: The NDRC was made for this moment. Since our founding in 2017, the NDRC and our affiliates have helped establish what The New York Times described in 2022 as the fairest national congressional map in 40 years. And in the past few months, we’ve seen fairer maps established in even more places, like Wisconsin, Alabama, and Louisiana. But our progress is constantly challenged, alongside new, brazen attempts to gerrymander — there is simply no “off season” in redistricting. I want to tell you exactly what we plan to achieve in the decade ahead. Because one thing is for certain: We can’t do it without you. Fighting for fair and representative maps is a crucial part of the fight to protect and enhance our democracy — and it goes well beyond one election cycle. (New, fairer maps were just finalized in Louisiana last month!) Now, playing the long-game doesn’t mean quietly going to the side and only showing back up at opportune moments. Instead, we’ve got to be actively engaged at all stages of the process. That’s why we’ve broken our plan into five parts: Developing state-of-the-art mapping capabilities: Technology and the use of AI are changing rapidly, and our investments in best-in-class mapping tools will ensure that we are always on the cutting edge, giving us a leg up in ensuring future maps are fairer than ever before. Shifting and building power in the states: The NDRC will build power so that we can shift power, investing in Democracy Defenders who are aligned with our mission in states across the country. Let’s ensure voters can choose their politicians, and not the other way around. Prioritizing grassroots mobilization and public education: We will mobilize supporters like you to get involved in efforts on the ground where they matter most, from fair redistricting to a fair and accurate 2030 Census. Pushing accountability efforts against bad maps and the corruption of redistricting processes: The NDRC and its affiliates will move the needle toward representative democracy by holding legislators accountable to their voters. That means playing defense to protect good process and fair maps, while going on offense to enforce the Voting Rights Act and challenge racial and partisan gerrymanders. Advancing redistricting reforms and policy changes at both the state and the federal level: We are already shaping improved redistricting processes in states that faltered during this past redistricting cycle, and we’re not stopping now. None of this work will lead to victories overnight or even all at once. Most days, it’ll feel like we’re playing whack-a-mole while running a marathon. But together, I know we can get far fairer maps in 2032. This plan is all about the long haul, and we need to know who’s committed to this fight alongside us.** We’ll have more soon about the best way to get involved in this work and keep up our momentum. For now, thank you! But last night, nearly a week since the decision came down, after widespread outrage from voters about the latest attempt to restrict reproductive freedom, Hawley broke his silence the only way he knows how during an election year — by rewriting his record:

MAGA Republicans like my opponent, funded by polluters and the fossil fuel industry, are fighting to protect profits at the expense of our planet.
They voted for devastating cuts to the National Park Service and the Environmental Protection Agency.

Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
Heidi Ganahl introduces the Rocky Mountain Voice, a new conservative news media platform for Coloradans to be the VOICE of your VALUES.

| Good evening, As we approach March 5th (Colorado's primary election and caucus), it's crucial that we all stay up to date on the happenings around Colorado. Please share Rocky Mountain Voice with your friends, family, and neighbors so we can continue growing our movement towards a more prosperous, thriving state. This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, February 27th, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
# TODAY'S TOP STORIES
---
[**Boebert is heavily favored in voter sentiment study, concluding ‘4th District is MAGA Country’**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
* Lauren Boebert leads the 4th Congressional District race with 48.7% support, followed by Trent Leisy, Richard Holtorf, and Mike Lynch. That's more than double the backing of any other candidate.

* Voters are all about: illegal immigration, voting rights, government benefits, border security, and cracking down on child and human trafficking.

* There's a strong pro-Trump sentiment, with constituents echoing his views on election security and calling out the Biden administration for what they see as intentional harm. Other significant issues in the district include Ukraine, the military, candidate ideologies, immigration, the economy, security, and the border.

| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
[**Disabled American Veterans facing statewide shortage of vehicles, drivers to take veterans to VA appointments**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Veterans across Colorado face challenges accessing medical treatment, often needing transportation to VA appointments, including those in Cheyenne, Wyoming, and Albuquerque, New Mexico. Colorado's Disabled American Veterans (DAV) transportation program is essential for providing rides, but there's a shortage of vehicles and drivers statewide.

* Concerns about the shortage of drivers were raised during a meeting of the Gene Doty Chapter 41 in Fort Morgan, highlighting the need for more volunteers, especially in areas like Fort Morgan to Loveland and Southeast Colorado. Donations and volunteers are sought to support the transportation program, with training provided for drivers. **Veterans in need of transportation assistance can contact the DAV for support.**

| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
[**Rep. Buck calls for House resolution for President Biden to be removed through 25th Amendment**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* President Joe Biden’s days in office would be numbered if a measure introduced Monday by U.S. Rep. Ken Buck, R-Windsor, is successful.

* His resolution calls upon Vice President Kamala Harris to gather members of the President’s cabinet to declare Biden “incapable of executing the duties of his office” under the 25th Amendment. It would lead to Harris immediately assuming office as the acting President.

* U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert, R-Silt, has additionally told the Rocky Mountain Voice she will file for articles of impeachment soon if Republicans don’t act as a result of investigations into Biden’s alleged roles in the business dealings of his son Hunter, where he may have received cash kickbacks from foreign governments filtered through family bank accounts.

| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
[**In Douglas County address, Lt. Col. West urges Republicans to fight for liberty, not amongst selves**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Lt. Col. Allen West addressed the Douglas County Republican Party's Lincoln Dinner, highlighting the importance of Colorado's political landscape as a reflection of national trends.

* West emphasized the need for Republicans to unite in defense of liberty amidst shifting political dynamics, urging them to focus on overarching ideals rather than personal rivalries. Concluding his remarks, West invoked the legacy of President Ronald Reagan and urged Republicans to uphold their principles as a beacon for the world.

| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
[**Concealed carry keeps growing in Colorado; over twenty-five thousand new permits in 2023**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* In 2023, Colorado saw **25,218 new concealed handgun permit holders and 36,291 permit renewals** , reflecting a continuous interest in concealed carry despite legislative efforts for restrictions.

* Over a five-year period from 2019-2023, more than 155,000 new permits were issued, with nearly 143,000 renewals. Despite efforts by majority Democrats in the state legislature to introduce bills aimed at making the concealed carry application process more stringent, concealed handgun permit holders are statistically among Colorado's most law-abiding citizens.

* Proposed legislation includes House Bill 24-1174, which seeks to expand training requirements and mandate a refresher class for permit renewal, and Senate Bill 24-131, which aims to restrict lawful carrying of firearms in various public spaces designated as "sensitive spaces."

| [ READ MORE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️** **[What does ‘Do Better Denver’ say about all of us, and the media?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY CORY GAINES | STATE | FEB 27** _I was recently introduced to a Twitter account called “Do Better Denver,” after reading about it in a Westword article. If you are like me and don’t live in Denver (or on Twitter), you may not be aware of who they are, but it’s not hard to describe._ **[Protect Kids Colorado launches to protect kids, strengthen families through citizens ballot initiatives](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY ERIN LEE | STATE | FEB 26** _Colorado is one of 24 states to have a Citizens Ballot Initiative process. Coloradans, that means “We the People” have a process by which to make law. Article V, Section II, Item 2.0, of the Colorado Constitution clearly lays out the people’s process by stating: “The first power hereby reserved by the people is the initiative...” The FIRST power._ [**Sen. Kirkmeyer details ‘bad bills’ and killed Republican initiatives in address to Weld County**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BRIAN PORTER | LOCAL, NORTHERN COLORADO | FEB 25** _T_ _he tools in the Republican toolbox for members of the Colorado House and Senate are few, limited by the majorities enjoyed by the Democrat party, Sen. Barbara Kirkmeyer told attendees here Saturday evening at the Weld County Republican Party’s Lincoln Dinner._ [**Get involved with Colorado’s postpartum pilot program**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY REBEKAH MEURER | LOCAL, NORTHERN COLORADO | FEB 25** _Do you value God, family and freedom? Do you stand for those values? Will you stand for God, country and freedom?__These are important questions in our present times. If you were to be asked what is the most under attack in the United States, what would your answer be?_ **Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share?** We'd love to talk with you about becoming an RMV Contributor. It’s _The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ by Mark Twain. **Unfortunately, political correctness has taken this literary classic out of the hands of far too many young Americans.** But here at Hillsdale College, we’re working to safeguard the legacy of this treasured classic, along with the legacy of the man regarded by many as **America’s greatest author.**

name: Your America
subject: National Referendum on Religious Liberty
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30906%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=RoIbABEpv02Wtwlhh6EPgA&sysid=1) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we’d see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That’s why I’m asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30907%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=D%2b2efOA2fQh5naGZXpE%2bpA&sysid=1) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer “sound learning” in order to preserve “the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty.”** Yet today’s ruling class mocks people of faith as “backward,” “bigots,” and even “Christo-fascists.” Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you “get bitter” and “cling to guns or religion.” These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today’s government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That’s why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America’s great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America’s leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include “Inside the Transgender Empire” by Christopher F. Rufo, “The Most Important Decision in Life” by Bishop Robert Barron, and “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including “The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,” “Ancient Christianity,” and “C.S. Lewis on Christianity”) consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we’ve seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30907%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=D%2b2efOA2fQh5naGZXpE%2bpA&sysid=1) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Your America News

name: 1600 Daily
subject: Russia and the United States
body:
Winston Churchill once described Russia as “a riddle, wrapped in a mystery, inside an enigma”

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zhhaleeimhfain30inhgs09trha3i645kngd5mfg_rp22sh2s8i6eo34shi61o32cth2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

Winston Churchill once described Russia as "a riddle, wrapped in a mystery, inside an enigma"--words that still ring true.

But given Russia's current war with Ukraine--and Russia's role in the shifting balance of power in today's world--a better understanding of Russia is critical.

Since Peter the Great, Russia's place among nations has only grown. As it transformed itself from a regional backwater to a great power, its politics and culture influenced significant events in our own history.

In the Cold War period between World War Two and the fall of the Soviet Union in 1991, American-Russian relations became the focus of world attention.

**The need for a better understanding of post-Cold War Russia, in light of its current importance and its long history as one of the world 's great powers, is why Hillsdale College has created a [FREE online video series on Russia](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zpl3r7n9l1b2sj1n0euqaeie7ap3p6ru8hi6rv9g_rp22sh2s8i6eo34shi61o32cth2bs). **

In our online video series, based on a recent conference held at Hillsdale College, you'll learn more about Russian history--including the "Greats" such as Peter and Catherine--with special attention to the Russian Revolution through the fall of the Soviet Union.

The video series also explores Russia's significant contributions to literature, through such authors as Dostoyevsky and Tolstoy--and to classical music, through such composers such as Tchaikovsky and Rachmaninoff.

**You 'll also gain a deeper understanding of Russia's enigmatic relationship with the West today, and about the causes and complications of the current Ukraine war. **

You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:

[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/russia-cca/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zdh7bedb9bq5u4qiiqu0moknumauchtahcc1hd38_rp22sh2s8i6eo34shi61o32cth2bs)

**Please use the secure link above to immediately receive your video series on Russia.**

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

subject: look at this sicko
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

My jaw hit the floor when I saw what a pro-abortion legislator, Representative Amanda Toll (D), in New Hampshire did just recently.

She brought her newborn baby to the floor of the New Hampshire State Legislature to **_BRAG_** about killing this child’s sibling via abortion a few years earlier.

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-shkktlt-duchtdja-y/)
Rep. Toll claimed, if she hadn’t aborted her child, she never could have become a politician . . .

I guess she’s bought the LIE that women somehow need abortion to succeed.

**_But even so, does wanting to become a politician give anyone the right to kill an innocent person_?**

To Rep. Toll, the answer is “YES!”

Pro-Life Friend, this is exactly what’s wrong with politics in America today.

Politicians don’t care about right or wrong – _or who lives or who dies_ – as long as it benefits them.

**[That’s why I’m counting on your financial support today for _Students for Life Action_ to help us EXPOSE these pro-abortion monsters for who they are](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-shkktlt-duchtdja-j/).**

You and I both know 2024 is an election year. It’s one of the most critical we’ve ever faced.

**It's going to be fought out in Battleground States just like New Hampshire and so many others.**

_And it’s already started_.

The fact is, I’m already busy recruiting students for the most MASSIVE Primary and General Election campaigns _Students for Life Action_ has ever conducted.

We’re going to target pro-abortion radicals just like Rep. Toll and expose exactly who they are with hard-hitting mail, email, digital ads, door-to-door work, phone banks, and texting.

But we’re counting on you to make it all happen.

**[So, please agree to your most generous contribution of $500, $250, $100, $50, or $25 TODAY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-shkktlt-duchtdja-i/)!**

Are politicians like Rep. Toll who we really want running America – _people who openly brag about killing their children so they can become politicians_?

The answer is “NO!”

Not if we want our country to survive.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. - Please say a prayer for the precious child Rep. Toll is holding.

body:
How important is religious liberty to you?

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zij8v765vcvfs2dtic8h71e6o6gpejahdvavmhq0_rp22sh2s8i6eo34shh68or4cth2bs) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ztq1qqjuhja3icn8t4m2966ne8boangufefh60bg_rp22sh2s8i6eo34shh68or4cth2bs) The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zk6puod1mtlp4lhjuvm2u10akb0j9sltr475f40g_rp22sh2s8i6eo34shh68or4cth2bs) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0t53ffigjj1iortivv5e2qmjdt4tdni0stucpe8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34shh68or4cth2bs) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Trump Train News

subject: Mark Twain is now available on DVD
body:
You may be shocked to learn that thousands of public schools have recently banned a classic American story.

| | | This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zuffas10ucisqj94fdjgrvima50gbekbg3k1nsfo_rp22sh2s8i6eo34shh68or4cth2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, You may be shocked to learn that thousands of public schools have recently banned a classic American story. Even if you haven’t read the book, you know the name. It’s _The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ by Mark Twain. **Unfortunately, political correctness has taken this literary classic out of the hands of far too many young Americans.** But here at Hillsdale College, we’re working to safeguard the legacy of this treasured classic, along with the legacy of the man regarded by many as **America’s greatest author.**
---
| | [**That is why I want to offer you a special DVD box set of our fascinating and important online course, “****Mark Twain:**_**Tom Sawyer**_**,**_**Huckleberry Finn**_**, and Selected Short Stories****.** ”](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zl6sthbp39nlh1hdtarsdem417hr1m53ik5ff758_rp22sh2s8i6eo34shh68or4cth2bs) Twain’s realist fiction reveals timeless truths about human nature. And while American life has certainly changed since the 1800s, human nature has not. So these literary works are as relevant and as important as ever. Now, we have created a special DVD version of our course that includes all nine lectures. And today, [**I’d like to send you this DVD box set as our way of thanking you for supporting our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty with a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztpknc87gaeco6j788hn0ekqub2s18sipqf7flio_rp22sh2s8i6eo34shh68or4cth2bs).
---

---

You can use this secure link to get your copy of **“Mark Twain:**_**Tom Sawyer, Huckleberry Finn**_**, and Selected Short Stories”** on DVD: [**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/support-hillsdales-online-courses-mark-twain**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zseo5ie3v2jb83l7pe0cqhretlkvrji54m98813g_rp22sh2s8i6eo34shh68or4cth2bs) Warm regards, Bill Gray, ’01 Vice President National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College P.S. | MANAKIN SABOT, VA -- 100% Pro-Trump 5th Congressional District candidate, former Navy SEAL, Virginia Senator, and business owner John McGuire today announced that he has been endorsed by fellow Navy SEAL and Congressman Derrick Van Orden.
---
| Navy SEAL & Congressman Derrick Van Orden Endorses John McGuire for Congress
---
| | |
---|---
|
Congressman Van Orden said:

"As a Navy SEAL, John McGuire has proven that he'll selflessly serve the people of this great country. Bob Good has proven that he'll only serve himself. Bob Good backstabbed President Trump when it counted and is not the kind of guy that people can count on. When Trump wins, we need America First candidates who will push his agenda. My fellow Navy SEAL John McGuire is the right guy to represent this district in Congress -- he understands what needs to be done to protect our country and support President Trump. I ask Virginians to send McGuire to Congress as he will not waver and will continuously support President Trump."

Paid for and Authorized by McGuire for Virginia
| McGuire said:
"I appreciate the support of my fellow SEAL brother Derrick Van Orden, a true warrior for America. And Derrick's right: when I'm in Congress, I'll be with Donald Trump 100% as I always have been... [unlike Bob Good."](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001dersL5jhgFKaEWzHgxqvXpiNqzeGvbWlgDCTvJ6lfvtpJJm3mF-3E81eIjS2lzzHk57-nvvXA5xH0cr4ygW_rByJ9U1n1XsQSwHlXY9EaHiMpv54jwp35dfuOjPi_5ePS8W06hcMMKOerogn8cwfOcHLI3YFapHUJuSWKRnlHadDF_vVkl-GsjtMCTjZ7-S0k5pXfcLjj9QgkxdLGuu1PQ==&c=Nm6mKa5OEqOze-MK01dtx5VhO7jHX_BFpnSPFLDfwgrK7Hwh39kmyg==&ch=9mXZAY7_f4DJ4qzbjvmWveQsSBUj-pj1-3HQDmF1q-J70tFuABK_Kg==)

| | Dear Fellow American, You may be shocked to learn that thousands of public schools have recently banned a classic American story. Even if you haven’t read the book, you know the name. It’s _The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ by Mark Twain. **Unfortunately, political correctness has taken this literary classic out of the hands of far too many young Americans.** But here at Hillsdale College, we’re working to safeguard the legacy of this treasured classic, along with the legacy of the man regarded by many as **America’s greatest author.**
---
| | [**That is why I want to offer you a special DVD box set of our fascinating and important online course, “****Mark Twain:**_**Tom Sawyer**_**,**_**Huckleberry Finn**_**, and Selected Short Stories****.** ”](http://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMUctu3DAM_Br5JoN6rHd98CGA41OSFu2hR4MrUbtC9TAkOUH_vnCa5NwjZ8gZcvjreX1GH3y6vWCkyYWylromXO8-BN7e0CduXy0v5FYJUnOQXF5W0dkJxGi17mgSZxiFUHDS3X0CPV4BaDCIeMWrMM4gjqjcMCqtL9j56dABKS9w0Sete5QwnJVzRp-UEM4wDRiotN4VIpsjJhv8lUr7U2jLpfUmxy5M99a2ytQDkwuTSyWzF7L9sXa1GKgnuzO5fNVHz74d8_wLqzyn4BNxk_dSqfKI5fe_o5laqmFqBtDD8AJSyydxmr_Nj48_mRz2Ftea92KIqXkruW5kmk-3DyqS9XtkaqaIPnyABuOG_paYmg-bd5fVvtpPOqdGqTE1f3_gy9MP_plSVya7vfkQfB3OTMPt0HzPoP3_u_4GAAD__yUcoCw) Twain’s realist fiction reveals timeless truths about human nature. And while American life has certainly changed since the 1800s, human nature has not. So these literary works are as relevant and as important as ever. body:
Friends,

Did you get a chance to read our previous email?

We here at Shift WA have consistently updated you on the "Let's Go Washington" initiatives during the legislative session, highlighting Democrat lawmakers' failure to hold public hearings.

There's progress - Democrats finally - and reluctantly - scheduled hearings for crucial initiatives like I-2113, I-2111, and I-2081. But the remaining three citizen initiatives have been left sitting on the sidelines.

[**To continue our work, we need your help. Please contribute $100, $50, or $25 today to meet our monthly goal and keep you informed.**](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62867003:WXofaJiND:m:1:2610672541:A63D2C4791B7B9F4F6F23935440CBB1F:r)

Thank you,

The Shift WA team

| Friends,

Because of leap year, we have one additional day to reach our monthly fundraising target! But we urgently need your support right now!

We hope that you have found Shift WA a dependable source for updates on the "Let's Go Washington" initiatives during the current legislative session. We've consistently shone a light on Democrat lawmakers who have failed to fulfill their constitutional duty by neglecting to hold public hearings for all six citizen initiatives certified for action.

Despite ongoing liberal resistance, there was a newsworthy breakthrough last week! Democrats reluctantly scheduled hearings for TODAY and TOMORROW to discuss three crucial initiatives: I-2111 (banning all future income taxes), I-2113 (allowing police pursuits), and I-2081 (ensuring parental rights in K-12 education).

Public pressure forced Democrats to schedule these hearings. We consider that a win, knowing that we played a role in keeping the public informed about what's really happening in Olympia.

[**To meet our monthly goal and sustain our work, we need your help. Please consider contributing $100, $50, or $25 today.**](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62867003:WXofaJiND:m:1:2610672541:A63D2C4791B7B9F4F6F23935440CBB1F:r)

name: David Hogg, Leaders We Deserve
subject: You don’t have to be obsessed with politics to know...
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blue Amp Action PAC
body:
| | | | |

| | |
---
| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tbdf99971-6a60-483b-b37f-86a7e1eb28a2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

| |

| | | Hey, Peter, thanks for opening this email. I know a lot is going on, so I appreciate it. It’s a little long, but it’s from the heart, and it’s important. You don’t have to be obsessed with politics or watching the news 24/7 to know our country is in a bad place. Horrific violence in the Middle East. A Republican Party that has gone so far off the rails they could barely elect a Speaker. The leading Republican candidate for president is Donald Trump! And then we have unspeakable atrocities like the mass shooting in Maine because our “leaders” refuse to act. And many people talk about how Trump is a major threat to democracy and he is — but I believe there is an even greater and more long-term threat \- hopelessness. When I was knocking doors for Leaders We Deserve-endorsed candidate Nadarius Clark for the Virginia elections, the most concerning answer I got when I asked if people were voting was, “No, I don’t believe in voting” or “No all politics is corrupt and my vote doesn’t matter.” This scares me because things can never get better if we continue electing people who say “government doesn't work” who then get elected and make it not work. I’m deeply worried about us. And it’s not because I’m anti-America. It’s because I love this country and I desperately want to see us do better. We’re not going to fix this mess overnight. But we do have a plan. A group of us just launched Leaders We Deserve. We started it because we know that young progressive leaders can change the future of this country for the better by giving us what we need most to get through this moment of democratic backsliding, HOPE. We can elect more young leaders like Nadarius Clark, but we can ONLY do it if enough of us get behind them. For us to give the school shooting generation the hope it needs to secure the future of our democracy and build a more perfect union, we must get to work electing the next generation of morally just leaders who put kids first and the NRA out of business. The truth is that young progressive candidates who are running for office face huge barriers. The average age of our elected officials is astronomical. That’s because our election system favors those who are older, wealthy, and white. In 2020, Millennial and Gen-Z individuals only held 21% of State Legislative seats despite representing 45% of the electorate. We launched Leaders We Deserve specifically to coalesce support from millions of Americans who believe in the promise of this younger generation. Here’s our plan:
* Find young progressives who are willing to run for Congress and state legislatures.
* Equip their campaigns with messaging, scheduling, and budget tools they need to win.
* And most importantly, raise funds from our massive national network (hey, that’s you!) to allow them to go toe-to-toe with their opponents and WIN.

Peter, if we succeed, ten years from now we’ll have shifted the politics of this nation dramatically. Young, progressive leaders will make up their fair share of the legislative and congressional seats, allowing us to right the ship and build the future we deserve. But what we do right now will determine whether or not that vision comes to pass. We can’t just muddle along raising a couple hundred thousand dollars here and there. We’ll actually have to raise tens of millions of dollars from grassroots donors like you to get the breadth and scale we need to win in all corners of the country. Here’s what I need from you for our plan to work. – If you are blessed with the financial ability to make a really big donation (like $500 or more), please do so right now to help us make this vision a reality. [Click here if you are fortunate enough to give $500 or more.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tdc66d73a-200d-4468-9871-2135e3fe0aab/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – If you can give a small donation each month, that makes a big impact too. [Click here if you think you can commit to a $25 monthly donation (or something like that).](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te020499c-e94e-4865-bfdb-1a11d9893168/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – If you can’t give big and you can’t give monthly, that’s totally OK (most people can’t). [Click here to just give a one time donation of whatever you can afford.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T19bf8342-0526-47a1-9a4d-4a7b67bd4077/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – Last but not least, if you can’t chip in at all, I completely understand. All I ask is that you forward this email to three friends who might be aligned with our cause. I hope this fundraiser is as successful as I know it can be. I hope that we look back at this moment in ten years and say THIS is when everything started to change. If you have any questions at all about Leaders We Deserve, please check out our website or get in touch with us on social media. From the bottom of my heart, thank you for reading today. \- David Hogg

Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Winston Churchill once described Russia as “a riddle, wrapped in a mystery, inside an enigma”

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qUbvPYHOg6HA9agGzyuNwg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnwat2P0STaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3J1c3NpYS1jY2EvP3NjPTAwOTQyTjAyNDJMMDZET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1ydXNzaWEmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwMjI4VwNzcGNCCmXVbQ_fZSiL7PxSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)

| | Dear Fellow American,

Winston Churchill once described Russia as "a riddle, wrapped in a mystery, inside an enigma"--words that still ring true.

But given Russia's current war with Ukraine--and Russia's role in the shifting balance of power in today's world--a better understanding of Russia is critical.

Since Peter the Great, Russia's place among nations has only grown. As it transformed itself from a regional backwater to a great power, its politics and culture influenced significant events in our own history.

In the Cold War period between World War Two and the fall of the Soviet Union in 1991, American-Russian relations became the focus of world attention.

**The need for a better understanding of post-Cold War Russia, in light of its current importance and its long history as one of the world 's great powers, is why Hillsdale College has created a [FREE online video series on Russia](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qUbvPYHOg6HA9agGzyuNwg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnwat2P0STaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3J1c3NpYS1jY2EvP3NjPTAwOTQyTjAyNDJMMDZET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1ydXNzaWEmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwMjI4VwNzcGNCCmXVbQ_fZSiL7PxSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA). **

In our online video series, based on a recent conference held at Hillsdale College, you'll learn more about Russian history--including the "Greats" such as Peter and Catherine--with special attention to the Russian Revolution through the fall of the Soviet Union.

The video series also explores Russia's significant contributions to literature, through such authors as Dostoyevsky and Tolstoy--and to classical music, through such composers such as Tchaikovsky and Rachmaninoff.

**You 'll also gain a deeper understanding of Russia's enigmatic relationship with the West today, and about the causes and complications of the current Ukraine war. **

You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:

[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/russia-cca/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qUbvPYHOg6HA9agGzyuNwg~~/AARclAA~/RgRnwat2P0STaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3J1c3NpYS1jY2EvP3NjPTAwOTQyTjAyNDJMMDZET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1ydXNzaWEmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwMjI4VwNzcGNCCmXVbQ_fZSiL7PxSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)

**Please use the secure link above to immediately receive your video series on Russia.**

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

# WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 28, 2024
---|---
**Good Morning**! On this date in 1953, two scientists walked into a British pub and announced, "We have discovered the secret of life." name: Anthony D'Esposito
subject: Official Announcement: Re-Election for NY4
body:
Peter, I am writing to you today with a sense of deep commitment and duty, as the Nassau County GOP has officially nominated me to seek re-election to Congress for NY4, encompassing Nassau County, Long Island.
[](https://despositoforcongress.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xhriudt-dytjdljkkt-r/) Peter, I am writing to you today with a sense of deep commitment and duty, as the Nassau County GOP has officially nominated me to seek re-election to Congress for NY4, encompassing Nassau County, Long Island. This nomination, endorsed by Chairman Joseph G. Cairo, Jr., and the Nassau County GOP committee members, is a privilege I do not take lightly.**[_Their continued trust in me is a testament to our shared dedication to the principles that guide our community and party._](https://despositoforcongress.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xhriudt-dytjdljkkt-j/)** My tenure as your representative in Congress has been driven by the same principles that guided me as an NYPD detective, the Island Park Fire Department Chief, and a Hempstead Town Council councilman. These roles have ingrained in me a profound understanding of our challenges and the resilience required to overcome them. **My commitment to ensuring our community's safety, prosperity, and freedom remains unwavering.** As we look forward to another term, I am reminded of the responsibilities that come with this nomination: **Ensuring Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Growth:**
**My experience has taught me the importance of prudent fiscal management and its impact on our community's prosperity.****Strengthening National Security and Public Safety Measures:**
**My background in law enforcement and fire safety underscores my commitment to the security and well-being of our citizens.****Protecting the Constitutional Rights of Our Citizens:**
**The liberties we hold dear are the foundation of our nation, and I am dedicated to safeguarding them.** The opportunity to serve NY4 again is not just a continuation of my service but a **renewal of my vow to advocate for and represent the best interests of our community.** Your trust and confidence in me during my first term have driven my efforts to make Nassau County a safer, more prosperous place to live.I am honored by the nomination from the Nassau County GOP and humbled by the possibility of continuing to serve you. [_**Your support has been the cornerstone of my service, and I look forward to representing you again.**_](https://despositoforcongress.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xhriudt-dytjdljkkt-t/) [DONATE NOW ->](https://despositoforcongress.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xhriudt-dytjdljkkt-i/) Thank you for your continued trust and support. Together, we will continue to face our challenges head-on and work towards a brighter future for all of Nassau County.Respectfully,
Anthony D'Esposito | | [Unsubscribe](https://despositoforcongress.cmail19.com/t/y-u-xhriudt-dytjdljkkt-d/)
---

body:
How important is religious liberty to you?

This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2f60378204b14a8895cbf08039b8ba85&_e=ho9DD_SB5SHLOCg7AnFkOBLPL7WKoxO8blVXG-2_f8tMT_4W2vpSohS27t75fj3LhbVWcaQrjs6d0M3sgzqE1puKTVGrPpoSSPE1QefSZ9RQxLcOc1clB98Wt48XMKjxXyd5A0zGvk2jXSieVVkb-TaNO2kteUt8UM7WfUbsNH0a-GehU0JTZL_zPkjmDdc6Mzoye2AsVsmUtWOkMaF9XWwFC2QwzZNzfdvx2lNh05qP09cWpNDncKhPqXFHHv_5pCQoCwh_SEeh77op9OvVip8j33syBv5_NGxfOZhSyx9IG_6WUEgRHBidPf0Jo2G2j-KVK_Gw5wOvZOLcq86AYh4kZ2FwZGZOZFPeNaxiWnF6nzAaOTMvq99cuokuCNdndY4XqY4HKHYws023n2jLqmOzA2diPHmDNOtbgmg67SM%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2f60378204b14a8895cbf08039b8ba85&_e=ho9DD_SB5SHLOCg7AnFkOBLPL7WKoxO8blVXG-2_f8tMT_4W2vpSohS27t75fj3LhbVWcaQrjs6d0M3sgzqE1puKTVGrPpoSSPE1QefSZ9RQxLcOc1clB98Wt48XMKjxXyd5A0zGvk2jXSieVVkb-TaNO2kteUt8UM7WfUbsNH0a-GehU0JTZL_zPkjmDdc6Mzoye2AsVsmUtWOkMaF9XWwFC2QwzZNzfdvx2lNh05qP09cWpNDncKhPqXFHHv_5nI613flmDan2Tscd2s7J4UcNaRtXYoR3-n5HmhIzhqkW5qi-qlLGAg4fl_BOjmzvm7iPVuOjDxjPGBBgg1VDygTqd5KI-0pOL_LN4HcRYVJaM1PBdptOMaTIOdiWgWuGmxwiVUYjaxTpggZWBgEr56Gchj7HcHH6-e_qXFuepYM%3D) The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2f60378204b14a8895cbf08039b8ba85&_e=ho9DD_SB5SHLOCg7AnFkOBLPL7WKoxO8blVXG-2_f8tMT_4W2vpSohS27t75fj3LhbVWcaQrjs6d0M3sgzqE1puKTVGrPpoSSPE1QefSZ9RQxLcOc1clB98Wt48XMKjxXyd5A0zGvk2jXSieVVkb-TaNO2kteUt8UM7WfUbsNH0a-GehU0JTZL_zPkjmDdc6Mzoye2AsVsmUtWOkMaF9XWwFC2QwzZNzfdvx2lNh05qP09cWpNDncKhPqXFHHv_51vIAzejzxD8-zSOd96Ubhp4oZAIFRcA5ki3sOT23GG59eftlylcln6kkA9K-5VlYBslGurV7fJdN2Q5iS5E0sjYqKfHoNZbo0WfzyNLnGcOAc52sX4-Kcx49KCnbtPEqg9Fh5s4hbn2mQxvbuuZ8lXRN27GBf0NL7fuXUOKIG0w%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2f60378204b14a8895cbf08039b8ba85&_e=ho9DD_SB5SHLOCg7AnFkOBLPL7WKoxO8blVXG-2_f8tMT_4W2vpSohS27t75fj3LhbVWcaQrjs6d0M3sgzqE1puKTVGrPpoSSPE1QefSZ9RQxLcOc1clB98Wt48XMKjxXyd5A0zGvk2jXSieVVkb-TaNO2kteUt8UM7WfUbsNH0a-GehU0JTZL_zPkjmDdc6Mzoye2AsVsmUtWOkMaF9XWwFC2QwzZNzfdvx2lNh05qP09cWpNDncKhPqXFHHv_5LTLfZ5imLn8IfI5tUsKWjSDbjows3f9dOttRuh7qszGKgwcWu12VKT35TkASE1HvPb0Op8HQwaJo7o0S6bJoRlEQpE_f4FqVfB3ALy0Sr-2mIQO-AUajRSPJr2vVWUjOQ8P7nRM7kybXoeMt9F7S3S6YJkHyw6s_c-w0J6sguZs%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the National Referendum on Religious Liberty by using the secure link below: Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. The first step is ...EDUCATION. Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is reaching and teaching millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our Project to Save Religious Liberty in America. These efforts include: Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country. Distributing Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon. Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty. Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the National Referendum on Religious Liberty and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies. I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. How important is religious liberty to you?

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0673b8cd8b6f47f5a03349caaf6e9547&_e=BCPMNj3M_jMOfcFe3LSbPcHDgxNaJtqZeHEgDChLBEkHhyjiZGJOx5cIoHlj_aQTMqzMzH6Z5vlAe6nBm6f99A28rOOfe3OS0pflaTmMUNuG7BS35VLX0Cr7aTfiszqxvkpN3ZqD-TVyD8KwCk34LS5SlN2xRYqZTMc2A7XlVCSRmK1vIWHYKH-SQ-x-ZbbNaKk_hLgNWBbrDqRopPfR2yDdAA3-ej0PF2oXnifIKPqfAWudWl_R1qsBDCGl-NN_Qy62SWTUqc2XUrU7xGI-krwWPDixSscxQNCf_TGBtFvhADfTWmF0PqVRIBhSAndLE1YSxIefMb414nStNZvbOwbVTntXUcvXKMP3Hm3nvp6i07H7ubaBrrIDqWwBL1CUVy2ISxuYqHdw3Qs-fmJnQWyBgBnYGkEe3hhSIZ0VePE%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0673b8cd8b6f47f5a03349caaf6e9547&_e=BCPMNj3M_jMOfcFe3LSbPcHDgxNaJtqZeHEgDChLBEkHhyjiZGJOx5cIoHlj_aQTMqzMzH6Z5vlAe6nBm6f99A28rOOfe3OS0pflaTmMUNuG7BS35VLX0Cr7aTfiszqxvkpN3ZqD-TVyD8KwCk34LS5SlN2xRYqZTMc2A7XlVCSRmK1vIWHYKH-SQ-x-ZbbNaKk_hLgNWBbrDqRopPfR2yDdAA3-ej0PF2oXnifIKPqfAWudWl_R1qsBDCGl-NN_rjrOxMe5N7aBnxqZsfW_0lNfvjCQTk7cFst9gtqUyAhXM8kSdcdVJ3KoHPg-BVtVd7affiw0H8NXrTgW2P5mWkVgk9kCZKJv9PeRaVqtlO9gF37RoEtOi8GW1Rdbl7WA20qqYZhCCc1X7S5sK2MDSDHrWJt_op2h1wDMgaN8U-M%3D) The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0673b8cd8b6f47f5a03349caaf6e9547&_e=BCPMNj3M_jMOfcFe3LSbPcHDgxNaJtqZeHEgDChLBEkHhyjiZGJOx5cIoHlj_aQTMqzMzH6Z5vlAe6nBm6f99A28rOOfe3OS0pflaTmMUNuG7BS35VLX0Cr7aTfiszqxvkpN3ZqD-TVyD8KwCk34LS5SlN2xRYqZTMc2A7XlVCSRmK1vIWHYKH-SQ-x-ZbbNaKk_hLgNWBbrDqRopPfR2yDdAA3-ej0PF2oXnifIKPqfAWudWl_R1qsBDCGl-NN_cMmSCOS2olouG58zeJaUUgimKh6nf0X6fUlzqb2nt1CjJ4UdN6zE_8XT7VlCJwR-V3yOlqzWLkz7nUyZW8h-DEeCCIpXpyNge6844lH6HAV5DnoKNk8qec9vhBt6b4vDfhSUWMz6ky743reurBY0IDNx9LOa4P4Y-3W47ASJ_pU%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0673b8cd8b6f47f5a03349caaf6e9547&_e=BCPMNj3M_jMOfcFe3LSbPcHDgxNaJtqZeHEgDChLBEkHhyjiZGJOx5cIoHlj_aQTMqzMzH6Z5vlAe6nBm6f99A28rOOfe3OS0pflaTmMUNuG7BS35VLX0Cr7aTfiszqxvkpN3ZqD-TVyD8KwCk34LS5SlN2xRYqZTMc2A7XlVCSRmK1vIWHYKH-SQ-x-ZbbNaKk_hLgNWBbrDqRopPfR2yDdAA3-ej0PF2oXnifIKPqfAWudWl_R1qsBDCGl-NN_JW_ER7E0CNZQipslxsWylk9D43Ghq67Ez3XotARiTqbcO7RiOwvvVIdyRxfQnkpldajd5Y4vldUAMcgGrbTRKNbg2OgA3G61HYyTEfPYtygZJmArnBVFPKZ5PUOU3OMz_YEFhytlp4rAQ-EreRQJyT6Rb8mGDr4odR60a0XgsTM%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |
