| | Dear Fellow American,

Winston Churchill once described Russia as "a riddle, wrapped in a mystery, inside an enigma"--words that still ring true.

But given Russia's current war with Ukraine--and Russia's role in the shifting balance of power in today's world--a better understanding of Russia is critical.

Since Peter the Great, Russia's place among nations has only grown. As it transformed itself from a regional backwater to a great power, its politics and culture influenced significant events in our own history.

In the Cold War period between World War Two and the fall of the Soviet Union in 1991, American-Russian relations became the focus of world attention.

**The need for a better understanding of post-Cold War Russia, in light of its current importance and its long history as one of the world 's great powers, is why Hillsdale College has created a [FREE online video series on Russia](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/yt06APpTqIw-4bgG1EQdCQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRnwbMyP0STaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3J1c3NpYS1jY2EvP3NjPTAwOTQyTjAyNDJMMDZET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1ydXNzaWEmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtQ0IyLTIwMjQwMjI4VwNzcGNCCmXVDR3fZQ8hZqtSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA). **

In our online video series, based on a recent conference held at Hillsdale College, you'll learn more about Russian history--including the "Greats" such as Peter and Catherine--with special attention to the Russian Revolution through the fall of the Soviet Union.

The video series also explores Russia's significant contributions to literature, through such authors as Dostoyevsky and Tolstoy--and to classical music, through such composers such as Tchaikovsky and Rachmaninoff.

**You 'll also gain a deeper understanding of Russia's enigmatic relationship with the West today, and about the causes and complications of the current Ukraine war. **

You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:

[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/russia-cca/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/yt06APpTqIw-4bgG1EQdCQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRnwbMyP0STaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3J1c3NpYS1jY2EvP3NjPTAwOTQyTjAyNDJMMDZET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1ydXNzaWEmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtQ0IyLTIwMjQwMjI4VwNzcGNCCmXVDR3fZQ8hZqtSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)

body:
How important is religious liberty to you?

This sponsored message from Defending the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d078ea131ee44f9b9aabb383eb4ac684&_e=ve-ze7U7_sthLmUHWZnOKLycw5YkYm5skJ01x3GFUvxUN7XXr2u_Iqwk1AdtzBsdStXu0Sb8O0LPSHnku4luhdwCSpU_FJr73emIoXQF-LTszbOYEkoDLY1yLGBiGRtQWAoUJV02h1QXPftOeUlGeYpFPk6ump6Wu1FlFnscCH1UZtJVFwYa9yhzMcjGhvMhokPLK4p0sInpxgN0ZRqXoEW5ui23QskVvL2hxXzRXzUedqTIewteMtWgXExmVvtyGYCn5zZwiEwZmg0FCR4ITSqYwKjGOHUPtORc8j9wtODfToXE7LuorMMxx7F1-epid8Bgfi7qO9YjwNO-9GMEolC_sd9XwS8vfQu86rh_ZABZwX-54Mw3UB35hQNOO2m4-phaLUsyr7eVc2pMpDh9c6Xqizj82t-nmNEQtfBDXno%3D) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d078ea131ee44f9b9aabb383eb4ac684&_e=ve-ze7U7_sthLmUHWZnOKLycw5YkYm5skJ01x3GFUvxUN7XXr2u_Iqwk1AdtzBsdStXu0Sb8O0LPSHnku4luhdwCSpU_FJr73emIoXQF-LTszbOYEkoDLY1yLGBiGRtQWAoUJV02h1QXPftOeUlGeYpFPk6ump6Wu1FlFnscCH1UZtJVFwYa9yhzMcjGhvMhokPLK4p0sInpxgN0ZRqXoEW5ui23QskVvL2hxXzRXzUedqTIewteMtWgXExmVvtyrIRNPjlgXqW7CqgR0d36b_jPKfQ6mG6ObgGf5jjdI9ZBUKjBB593j5bzz21BXz_LFPGYlpvdAtmq8MQ8MttO80TAlBrKJBqOR12XrplT9-GfNJH5B9bIQZEgXc3TePmXgijMaZBMRgpZAbI9merEP9lT4eNXaaN3DwQ8iHDARCw%3D) The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d078ea131ee44f9b9aabb383eb4ac684&_e=ve-ze7U7_sthLmUHWZnOKLycw5YkYm5skJ01x3GFUvxUN7XXr2u_Iqwk1AdtzBsdStXu0Sb8O0LPSHnku4luhdwCSpU_FJr73emIoXQF-LTszbOYEkoDLY1yLGBiGRtQWAoUJV02h1QXPftOeUlGeYpFPk6ump6Wu1FlFnscCH1UZtJVFwYa9yhzMcjGhvMhokPLK4p0sInpxgN0ZRqXoEW5ui23QskVvL2hxXzRXzUedqTIewteMtWgXExmVvty-jztE1Ze-crUycIIEmlVrqqL4spo1c1owTcAakOSgoxJTc01IbiIf7FO5-V4eTfqAI9hXe8j4K5pSjr5MmtPCSz9KTfs9NeYgheGyNtz600DoNYSMGBVUl45gADM1PtYM1R80lENU8LuLWia8MmkWMg3FySUwJ1OY8d9LpbE96U%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d078ea131ee44f9b9aabb383eb4ac684&_e=ve-ze7U7_sthLmUHWZnOKLycw5YkYm5skJ01x3GFUvxUN7XXr2u_Iqwk1AdtzBsdStXu0Sb8O0LPSHnku4luhdwCSpU_FJr73emIoXQF-LTszbOYEkoDLY1yLGBiGRtQWAoUJV02h1QXPftOeUlGeYpFPk6ump6Wu1FlFnscCH1UZtJVFwYa9yhzMcjGhvMhokPLK4p0sInpxgN0ZRqXoEW5ui23QskVvL2hxXzRXzUedqTIewteMtWgXExmVvtyJxUydwblOb7f8IMBamZX4ddp3KmGyDQ566NddaTOiD-TMxzD2JdSEvT9ypggOCPZaMlNedwM4P2h41O-ydlTbeyoe83Q6Jtd8-ldBsx3xXkSUoQ8F0GowddWY43egu-X-VNfzcmTTe2Nt_9DWL_-9x238Y2XF2yMj1AZQhhNyqQ%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Defend the Constitution

Winston Churchill once described Russia as “a riddle, wrapped in a mystery, inside an enigma”

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b72324a262b64799bced7f5fa6274a4b&_e=ExKYRaKFkLPxVpKFA5Jt8f15dIFZo1Z6iKqIU_Lg3jeOqXKNuBmApK3nvWDYwXPbVDq0414niZc4XYoLcZsExKAN564EfJU0g08WX_8WOQlAnbkoe5qQZQnSbYuUbIxidBsQNkXlR4XHAujeYCSA4eExy5OHbG6jpiFvvei810bDrMLBS4brsmiUs7G1mS6fvK5HBFqPqnVOd0o-8Wjqyoo4k7OI2AYc0_4rks2bf-QUsy1fIlkIQUE78p0KVWs-IUOC8wRl43BadSnESDPzrCvgL-q4uah5grSDknVMORDi1ns_V_EGdHUYi9DwhowYxlCeGBYJw8q9dysaMusQFGGNxasKiAxqdvq7dEGBVjk%3D)

| | Dear Fellow American,

Winston Churchill once described Russia as "a riddle, wrapped in a mystery, inside an enigma"--words that still ring true.

But given Russia's current war with Ukraine--and Russia's role in the shifting balance of power in today's world--a better understanding of Russia is critical.

Since Peter the Great, Russia's place among nations has only grown. As it transformed itself from a regional backwater to a great power, its politics and culture influenced significant events in our own history.

In the Cold War period between World War Two and the fall of the Soviet Union in 1991, American-Russian relations became the focus of world attention.

subject: Never eat almonds, spinach and peanut butter (Here's why)
body:
[View in Web Browser](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8kMtu6jAURb_mZEZkbzuxGXhwb9NUqtQRgrZD4wexcCBKAlX-voLSTs9j7aVt-yGnuBhS_wnokp8IIPGPgMssdna7fRuX1aduVi_VDofbEk8EzMsQ_i4fkDL0NuXbVDWFNxKWR1cEwxVbc1RS6aIzTFaWcXjvWF0JpWoua8f0Wjpw8KiLZMAgGaC5YILXJd_rEKUIVivpggwk2T2ojGMIc5dOxzB6m_JSunNfZNPN8zDdxVpCe_b78nRxOVymny937gntQ5nQXgktduNHJTbP6w2J9l6CaN51E4-v_lqMxg9fKec01YokO_xSvgMAAP__XzxdxA)

If you've been led to believe that peanut butter, almonds and spinach are good for you, today's email might shock you and is important to read, because these 3 healthy foods could be contributing to health problems in your body.

Let's take a quick look at why...

**1\. Peanut butter**

While peanut butter does contain a small amount of protein and vitamins/minerals, the cons outweigh the pros on this food.

First of all, peanuts contain one of the highest concentrations of aflatoxin, which is a mold toxin that is created in peanuts due to storage in moist conditions.

Peanut butter is also very high in inflammatory omega-6 fats and due to the processing of peanut butter, those omega 6 fats are in a harmful oxidized state.

Most people already get too much omega 6 fats from vegetable oils (soy, corn, canola, etc), and this contributes to insulin resistance, heart disease, brain inflammation, cancer, and lots more health problems, since most people are currently eating 5-10x more omega-6 fats than we should be eating in a healthy diet.

Lastly, peanut butter also contains medium amounts of oxalates, which are plant-based antinutrients that when consumed in excess can contribute to kidney stones, thyroid and gut problems, joint problems and more.

We'll talk more about oxalates in the next food...

**2\. Spinach**

Spinach is promoted as a healthy green, but contains FAR more downsides than good sides. Spinach is one of the highest oxalate foods that's commonly eaten by modern humans (in addition to beet greens, beets, almonds, and other veggies and nuts).

The amount of oxalates in a serving of spinach is extremely high, up to 600 mg in a normal sized bowl.

The "safe" amount of oxalates in a daily diet according to world renowned oxalate expert Sally Norton should be between 100-200 mg per day total to avoid a lot of the health problems caused by high oxalate plants.

So, you can see how concerning spinach is with the extremely high oxalate levels.

As mentioned above, eating too much oxalates too frequently can cause serious issues such as kidney stones, thyroid problems, gut damage, skin issues, and joint pain.

In fact, some people have even gotten "oxalate poisoning" by eating green smoothies too often and had to go to the ER for kidney failure.

**3\. Almonds**

Although almonds and almond milk are marketed as healthy, they also contain many downsides, including all of the negatives mentioned above about too much omega 6 fats and too much oxalates.

They're probably ok in your diet occasionally, but I personally avoid eating almonds too often because of these issues with excess oxalates and omega 6 fats.

Now let's take a look at a fun little quiz below and a few more foods...

**Bananas vs oranges vs apples... (the #1 WORST fruit for your gut & energy)**
According to the best-selling author and world-renowned heart surgeon, Dr. Steven Gundry, there's one fruit people over 40 should never eat.

This fruit can **damage your gut and disrupt your hormones**. Both sapping you of energy and **forcing your body to create "sticky" fat cells that can NOT be "burned off" with normal diet and exercise. **

Do you know the fruit I'm talking about? Make sure you do by clicking the one below you think it is, and get the answer from Dr. Gundry himself on the next page:

**So, after I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local donut shop.** It was just a minimum wage job, but the small checks I brought home gave my family room to breathe. Finally, after a lot of hard work, the possibilities that we could only dream of before became reality.
We were able to move out of that one room apartment, and I got a scholarship to an incredible college. Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. That call to service took me to places I had never even dreamed of before. **I became the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and now, I'm running for the United States Senate.**
**Making donuts in the morning before homeroom brought me all the way to Congress. ****I've seen time and time again how small acts have the power to create big, transformative change._And that's exactly how we're going to win this campaign in November._**

Tom Cotton was born and raised on his family's cattle farm in Arkansas, served as an Army infantry officer in Iraq and Afghanistan, and is fighting for working Americans in the U.S. Senate.

The tragic attacks of September 11, 2001 occurred during Tom's final year of law school and changed his life's trajectory.

After clerking on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit and spending a short time in private law practice, he joined the United States Army as an Infantry Officer, spending nearly five years on active duty.

Between his two combat tours he served as a platoon leader with the Old Guard at Arlington National Cemetery, the unit responsible for military honors funerals.

Tom's military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal, Combat Infantry Badge, and Ranger Tab.

This isn’t a real deadline, but it is the next marker on the road to November." -Team Cotton | | | | | | | | Meet Tom Cotton Tom Cotton was born and raised on his family's cattle farm in Arkansas, served as an Army infantry officer in Iraq and Afghanistan, and is fighting for working Americans in the U.S. Senate. The tragic attacks of September 11, 2001 occurred during Tom's final year of law school and changed his life's trajectory. After clerking on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit and spending a short time in private law practice, he joined the United States Army as an Infantry Officer, spending nearly five years on active duty. Between his two combat tours he served as a platoon leader with the Old Guard at Arlington National Cemetery, the unit responsible for military honors funerals. Tom's military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal, Combat Infantry Badge, and Ranger Tab. In the U.S. Senate, he's fighting the tough battles for Arkansans and Americans, and delivering real results. He knows that only the strong can survive in a dangerous world, and he's building a movement to make America strong again. | | Senator Cotton was honorably discharged from the U.S. Army. Vice President Kamala Harris announced Tuesday that college students
would be able to collect federally-funded work study for registering
voters. Harris’s announcement of the new policy was posted on X,
formerly known as Twitter. The federal work-study program is intended
to allow students to earn money for day-to-day expenses while at
college, according to the Department of Education.

Hi Derek —
it’s Lexi, Adam’s daughter!

While you might think of him as Congressman, Representative, or just Adam
— to me, he’s Dad.

With just a few days left in the Senate primary, [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=feb2024_abs_em.yNAKTE&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240228_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=5732%2E5257348%2Ee4UxHR ]I’m hoping you can
pitch in a few bucks to my dad’s campaign.

I’ve learned a lot from my dad, like how to pack for a trip...

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=feb2024_abs_em.yNAKTE&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240228_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=5732%2E5257348%2Ee4UxHR ]Adam and Lexi walking towards the airport with luggage in hand

Or how to make phone calls (he had me calling voters at a young age 😅 )...

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=feb2024_abs_em.yNAKTE&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240228_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=5732%2E5257348%2Ee4UxHR ]Lexi phone banking as a toddler

Cute photos aside, I’ve truly learned so much watching my dad at work.

He lives to serve others — his friends, his family, and every Californian.
He is always willing to offer help and support to those who need it. No
matter where he goes, it’s the very first question he asks.

How can I help? And he means it.

Growing up, my dad would tell us stories about the people he'd met from
our district, their concerns about their jobs, their families, and all of
the things that they wanted to be different in our country — the issues
that mattered most to them.

My first thought hearing those stories as a kid was always that it must be
so hard to listen to them every day and have people expect so much from
you as just one person. But my dad always told us that it was the best
part of the job. The chance to hear people's struggles and honest concerns
and work to address them — and make their lives better.

That's what truly and genuinely motivates him at his core — and that’s
what I know he will bring to the Senate if we can elect him there. The
humanity and the unrelenting passion to change people's lives for the
better, and make our country and our world a better place to live in.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=feb2024_abs_em.yNAKTE&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240228_AM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1007&akid=5732%2E5257348%2Ee4UxHR ]So before my dad’s primary election, I would really appreciate it if
you could make a contribution. What do you say,
Derek? Can you chip in
$10 to my
dad’s campaign?

**“Through collaboration with diverse cultures, Latino Victory Fund paves the way for progress, bringing us one step closer to a future where unity fuels our collective success.” - Joseph Alfonso**

name: Shamaine Daniels
subject: We're On The Ballot! What's Next?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Daniels For Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Dear Friend,
Thanks to the incredible support of nearly 100 volunteers, I was proud to submit the required signatures to get onto the primary ballot to represent Pennsylvania’s 10th Congressional District in Congress. The volunteers and I spent hours and hours talking to our neighbors and friends about what is important to them and their families. I was grateful for the opportunity to talk directly with the folks I hope to represent in Congress. Those conversations reinforced in me exactly what’s at stake in this election and why I am the best candidate to beat Scott Perry in November.
While our conversations touched on many topics, there are a few I want to highlight:
Working families in our district are struggling. Inflation is too high, jobs don’t pay enough, and the costs of healthcare and childcare are ridiculous. This wasn’t news to me. As a mother with a toddler, I know firsthand the struggle so many in our district are having to make ends meet. That is why I will go to DC to fight for a living wage, support efforts to expand pre-K and vote to cap prescription drug costs.
Immigration isn’t just some random thing happening at the border. Our district is medically underserved and our family farms are closing. These cost our district jobs and opportunities for economic growth. That is why I support comprehensive immigration reform that includes reforming our visa programs to allow more doctors and farm workers to come to our district and make sure our hospitals have the specialists they need and our farms have the labor needed to plant and harvest their crops.
Women’s rights are under attack. First, Roe v. Wade was overturned, limiting healthcare options for women across the country. Now, extreme politicians are coming after IVF treatments for families. The women I spoke with are worried about what’s next. That’s why, in Congress, I will continue my lifelong fight to protect a woman’s right to make her own healthcare decisions.
I look forward to continuing these conversations as the campaign moves forward. As we near the end of the month, our campaign is coming up to a crucial fundraising deadline and we need your help.
Our campaign is fueled by grassroots donors and every contribution counts! Please contribute what you can by clicking here before the incredibly important Feb 29th fundraising deadline. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
With gratitude,
Shamaine

Apple is ditching its decade-long venture to develop an electric car as demand for them slows down, Bloomberg reported on Tuesday. The tech giant began working on the electric vehicle (EV) around 2014 and spent billions on it, but its work is now coming to a close, according to individuals familiar with the situation who spoke to Bloomberg.

| Peter,

Last week, the Alabama Supreme Court issued a ruling that puts vital reproductive rights at risk, including those related to In Vitro Fertilization (IVF). This decision not only threatens the dreams of countless families wishing to conceive but also marks a significant step backward in the fight for reproductive freedom.

The implications of this decision extend far beyond Alabama's borders, setting a dangerous precedent that could influence future rulings and legislation across the country. It's a direct attack on the rights of individuals and couples to choose how they build their families, and it risks the well-being and autonomy of many.

**In Congress, I’m committed to continuing my fight to protect our bodily autonomy and codify _Roe v. Wade_ amidst Republican assaults on reproductive rights. | | | **The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service has proposed a rule that would end the senseless slaughter of several native species in National Wildlife Refuges.** Add your name and help make it happen. **[Tell the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service you support this new rule>> ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T617f03fa-0181-4c7d-8fcf-e0f00f6f11fb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Currently, bears, wolves, cougars, and other native animals are killed via predator control programs -- which allow cruel methods like shooting animals from the air, trapping and snaring, or chasing them with radio-collared hounds. **It's unnecessary, cruel, and outdated, and there are far better ways to keep the system in balance. ** This new rule would be a huge step forward in the protection of native animals, but it must be finalized and implemented quickly if it's to happen. [**Add your name and tell**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T449b49d6-8a80-4823-9fae-10cd59f2e127/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**[the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service you support this new rule>> ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4201e328-2057-4cbd-b8a5-0de09e311278/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: They’re desperate to take back power. But we are determined to stop them.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
With your support, we can win this race, keep control of the Senate, and pass bold reforms that make meaningful change for working people.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1946%2E4032634%2EfbDfZU)
---
Republicans are itching to take back the U.S. Senate this year. And I officially have a well-funded GOP challenger who’s trying to help make it happen. With a Senate majority, Republicans could block President Biden’s plans — all obstruction, all the time. Or they could rubber-stamp Donald Trump’s agenda, reverse the progress we’ve made for working people, and ban abortion nationwide, even in places like Massachusetts that respect reproductive rights. We can’t let that happen. And I’m not taking anything for granted in my race for re-election: my opponent will have support from the GOP and deep-pocketed special interest groups, so we’ve got to be ready to push back. [**Can you pitch in a donation of $28 or any amount to support our re-election campaign and help defend our Democratic majority in the Senate?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1907?amount=28&t=8&akid=1946%2E4032634%2EfbDfZU)

| | When I ran for Congress, I received a lot of good advice, and I remember clearly what Spokane Mayor Lisa Brown told me. She stated that when she ran for Congress in 2018, she underestimated the importance of rural voters, which she believes may have cost her the race. Despite having an enormous war chest, she literally could not spend it all in the short span of the election. The Union Bulletin recently published an [article](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/fbOtmGf5J/c?w=cEW447PaJYb6SCXHCIwdqj53df9Rr31qVFPPl_7gxVM.) stating that this was the best time for Democrats to flip Washington’s Congressional District 5 (CD5), and there is a good reason for it because we know what needs to be done. Rural Americans United is predicated on learning from the many mistakes made by individuals like myself, others, and truly listening to our constituents, even when what we hear goes against what we personally believe. It is still more important to listen and act on the interests of our constituents. From a numbers game, we know we can win in CD5 because that is what the voters are telling us. Recently, Spokane elected a Democratic Mayor, and the incumbent is exiting long before her career needs to end. Additionally, as reported by [Politico](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/fbOtmGf5J/c?w=k9N35f2xOf6jdrtxNVZIil3OvFhlyLTWYTi5ByhZfAQ.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucG9saXRpY28uY29tLzIwMjAtZWxlY3Rpb24vcmVzdWx0cy93YXNoaW5ndG9uLyIsInIiOiI2OTBlYTQ0OC1hN2UyLTQyMjMtOTUyNy01ZTVlYzk0ZjFlYWUiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ), Whitman County voted for Biden in 2020 by 10%, in Walla Walla County Biden lost by only 6%, and in Spokane County, it was only 4%. These three counties make up approximately 80% of all voters, and a Democrat losing by single digits anywhere East of the Cascades is considered a Swing District if not an actual win. Party politics is often a nuanced dance by politicians, but by listening to constituents, we already know some platform positions. The first is to stay away from education or find a way to support parents' roles without bringing up culture wars. The Republican Party has made a rally cry out of homeschool, voucher programs, dismantling the Department of Education, breaking the teachers' union, anti-WOKE, and anti-LGBT+. Abortion is another kill stroke for rural Democrats. A woman’s right to autonomy over her body is absolute, but this most delicate issue must be framed in context of everyone’s right to bodily autonomy; it is freedom of self-determination. Immigration is a focal topic of the 2024 elections, and Democratic candidates will need to be well-positioned to address their constituents. In CD5, immigration as an issue, at least on the surface, appears more straightforward than in neighboring CD4. Data shown by [DataUsa.io](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/fbOtmGf5J/c?w=fbKomNNW-ru7ZVZJ3x1NEd1Ujq00YA2-A9LShtaqtWQ.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9kYXRhdXNhLmlvLyIsInIiOiI2OTBlYTQ0OC1hN2UyLTQyMjMtOTUyNy01ZTVlYzk0ZjFlYWUiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) indicates that CD5 is a majority White district (82%), with persons identifying as non-White and non-Hispanic making up the majority of remaining residents. This coupled with a high citizenship rate of over 97%, suggests that an immigration platform can be less nuanced, and therefore a Democratic candidate can take a stronger position and hold that ground. In CD4, where the Latinx population is roughly 50% and citizenship is below 90%, more dimensions must be included in any meaningful discussion of immigration; dimensions that affect people’s lives in real and meaningful ways. It is hard to imagine anywhere else in the country where so many factors come into play with regard to immigration than in CD4. Discussing money in politics, it's important to note that simply throwing money at a campaign doesn't guarantee success. As Lisa Brown shared with me, she had more money than she could spend, yet it didn't secure victory. Every politician, consultant, and voting record will show you that facts don’t win elections; emotions do. Having strangers or candidates making aggressive promises at the last minute will win few favors. To truly win, we must connect with the hearts and minds of people on the issues that matter most to them and be there every day. Rural Americans United understands this, which is why we've launched our pro-democratic messaging campaign. We are educating, reminding, and persuading people that democratic values mirror theirs most closely and will give us the future we all deserve. Additional Sources: [Progressive Strategies NW](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/fbOtmGf5J/c?w=UxC014p6YHRKYEaKCqz2aSNXy1qNCbw8nNRSkXdY21E.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9tYWlsY2hpLm1wL2ZiOGNiNWVhNTI1ZC9vbi1ob21lbGVzc25lc3Mtc3BlbmRpbmctdm90ZXItcGF0aWVuY2UtZ3Jvd3MtdGhpbi0xMjY3OTAwMj9lPTM3Yzk4MDkyYjUiLCJyIjoiNjkwZWE0NDgtYTdlMi00MjIzLTk1MjctNWU1ZWM5NGYxZWFlIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0)

I’m living proof that this truly is the land of opportunity

Friend,

My faith in America has never wavered.

I'm reminded of the countless blessings that grace our lives -- blessings that resonate deeply within the core of our American spirit. This is the greatest country on earth; we must never forget that.

I'm living proof that America truly is the land of opportunity. **[To the radical Left that says we're an evil, declining country, I say the truth of my life disproves your lies.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zi7qh5kcgdqbh40svolgurhudd8ntdnldvghg6h8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34shim8or6cjh2bs)**

Friend, Senate Republicans are hard at work to reject the Left's valueless vision for our country. We're fighting for an agenda driven by faith, patriotism, and personal responsibility -- **[but we can't do it without you.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z0h8takdrl31jl7pr13iblqkku6c8u136msjj7b8_rp22sh2s8i6eo34shim8or6cjh2bs)**

body:
# [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79899307/457841883/18334046?refcode=UTS_FR_FULL_20240228_1_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5NDc2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc5NzEzNWViLTRlZDYtZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=uAhNbXIvBVpmmP8dpXxGN2yVWuiQchuJrTY3549AXWk=)
Peter, it’s Tammy Baldwin. I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you a little more about myself, why I ran for the U.S. Senate, and why our campaign in Wisconsin is so important.
**When I was a child, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital.** When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future.
But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket — and they had to make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I was a child labeled with those words: "pre-existing condition."
Peter, I got into public service because I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. No one should ever have to go through that.
**Like 133 million Americans, I know what it's like to have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to my care — and before the Affordable Care Act was passed, many of us could be denied coverage.**
Today, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and fought to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. These policy changes have led to millions more Americans getting the health insurance they need.
So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — people like me. The GOP has spent years playing politics with people’s lives. And if Mitch McConnell and his Republican megadonors flip my seat in Wisconsin and take hold of the Senate majority next election, countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules.
The people of Wisconsin did not send me to Washington to take people’s health care away, which is why I fought against Republican repeal efforts and why I will never back down. But I can’t defend the hard-fought progress we’ve made without your help, Peter.

When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Last night, Donald Trump won the Michigan primary in a landslide – taking 68.2% of the vote and securing 9 additional delegates.
With Trump’s victories in Iowa, New Hampshire, Nevada, South Carolina, and now here, he is well on his way to winning the 1215 delegates needed to secure his nomination. That's why we're writing to ask you to contribute $3 to Elissa Slotkin's Senate campaign in Michigan today. Especially today.

$3 because if Elissa can win this Senate race, we know that means it will be nearly impossible for Donald Trump to also carry the state.
$3 because Republicans know this too, and it's why they will pour tremendous amounts of money into the state to defeat us. In fact, we’ve already seen dark money conservative groups up on TV with ads.

The Collective PAC has continued to support and fund Black candidates since 2016, all while engaging and mobilizing Black voters.

In the last three years, thanks to contributions from supporters like you, we’re registered more than 200,000, provided more than 100,000 rides to and from the polls, and made nearly _5 million voter contact attempts._

But that’s not all — we also endorsed and financially supported _**400**_ Black candidates we’ve helped elect to local, state, and federal offices.

2024 is shaping up to be one of our most important election years to date, and our endorsed Black candidates need our support now more than ever. That’s why we’re asking you, Peter.

| | **My promise to you is this: I will ALWAYS be an independent voice for Kansas’ 3rd District.** I’m an outsider to politics. I don’t owe party bosses anything, and I have no problem calling out something I disagree with, whether it’s a Democrat or a Republican pushing it. **I’m running for Congress because we can’t say the same thing about Sharice Davids. ** **She votes with Joe Biden 100% of the time. Let that sink in. 100% of the time. ** That means she’s signed off on every single bad spending bill and every attack on our energy independence. body:
|
#
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79905947/457862547/1221027587?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC60_20240228_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2N2I3YjkwNy01NmQ2LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HZFlA2oICp5n95fenycugUnXOiHz66HfLFzycAO6kkk=) Hi there, it's Lisa Blunt Rochester – I'm running to become the first woman and the first Black person to represent Delaware in the Senate. This Black History Month, I have been reflecting on so many of the Black leaders and visionaries from the past and who are living among us today. Throughout history, Black Americans have made invaluable contributions to this country despite facing barriers, adversity, and injustice every step of the way. One of the barriers that we, as Black Americans, have faced is not having sufficient representation in our government – and even today, we still have a long way to go. I'm going to tell you a little bit more about why representation matters, but first, **[can I ask that you make a split contribution of $5 between my campaign and Tina Smith?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79905949/457862549/1221027587?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&amount=5&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC60_20240228_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2N2I3YjkwNy01NmQ2LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HZFlA2oICp5n95fenycugUnXOiHz66HfLFzycAO6kkk=)** | [CHIP IN >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79905951/457862551/1221027587?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC60_20240228_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2N2I3YjkwNy01NmQ2LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HZFlA2oICp5n95fenycugUnXOiHz66HfLFzycAO6kkk=)
---
In its 234-year history, the United States Senate has had 2,003 Senators – but only three of them have been Black women. **Let me be blunt and say: that is not enough.**
Representation in our government is so important. When we see ourselves reflected in positions of leadership and influence, it sends a powerful message that our voices are valued. And it also ensures that our government is working for everyone, not just a select few.
The historic nature of this campaign is not lost on me, but I am not in this fight just to make history. I am in this fight to make sure that every Delawarean’s voice is heard and every perspective is represented.
In order for all of this to be possible, we need to hold the Senate majority. Trump, McConnell, and the MAGA machine are preparing to throw everything they have at Delaware to flip our state red. This would spell serious trouble for our majority.
**[This Black History Month, I'm asking you to help our campaign increase representation in the Senate by winning in November. clean_body: | = Hi there, it's Lisa Blunt Rochester – I'm running to become the first woman and the first Black person to represent Delaware in the Senate. This Black History Month, I have been reflecting on so many of the Black leaders and visionaries from the past and who are living among us today. Throughout history, Black Americans have made invaluable contributions to this country despite facing barriers, adversity, and injustice every step of the way. One of the barriers that we, as Black Americans, have faced is not having sufficient representation in our government – and even today, we still have a long way to go. I'm going to tell you a little bit more about why representation matters, but first, = | = In its 234-year history, the United States Senate has had 2,003 Senators – but only three of them have been Black women. Let me be blunt and say: that is not enough. Representation in our government is so important. When we see ourselves reflected in positions of leadership and influence, it sends a powerful message that our voices are valued. And it also ensures that our government is working for everyone, not just a select few. The historic nature of this campaign is not lost on me, but I am not in this fight just to make history. I am in this fight to make sure that every Delawarean’s voice is heard and every perspective is represented. In order for all of this to be possible, we need to hold the Senate majority. Trump, McConnell, and the MAGA machine are preparing to throw everything they have at Delaware to flip our state red. ---
| | We began the 2024 General Assembly session with legislators introducing 2,816 bills and resolutions. Moving at a rapid pace, committees have been meeting to deliberate these introduced policies, sometimes altering their initial concepts before advancing in the legislative process or sending the patron to continue their work in the interim for next session. February 13, was the deadline for the House and Senate to complete action on those bills in each respective body. Known as “crossover” only 1,341 bills survived and remained for us to act on over the next three weeks.

#
**Crossover Update**

---
| | We were no exception to the legislative process and while we began the session with a full agenda of 21 bills, we’ve since had bills pass, incorporated into other bills, and even failed to advance. We’ve also partnered with other legislators to collaborate on policies that also stand to benefit our district. The status of our agenda is as follows:
* **Education** : Community Builders Violence Intervention Pilot Program (SB 484); Community Schools Planning and Implementation Grants (SB 608); Child Social Media Data Protection Act (SB 359) and At-Risk-School Funding (SB 105).
* **Healthcare** : Recognizing Black Maternal Health Week (SJ 23) and DMAS LRI Modifications (SB 488).
* **Worker Protections:** Overtime for Domestic Workers (SB 494)
* **Community Development & Housing:** Enforcement of Landlords by Localities (SB 479); Derelict and Blight Property Tax Enforcement (SB 477) and Vacant Building Registration (SB 48)
* **Consumer Protections:** Utility Disconnection Restrictions (SB 480)
* **Environmental** : Comprehensive Plans for Healthy Communities Strategy (SB 595) and Electric Vehicle Charging Station Fund (SB 45)
* **Good Governance:** Localities in Fiscal Distress, APA Action (SB 645); JLARC Study for Rural Cabinet Secretary (SJ 21) and Artificial Intelligence Regulations and Commission ( SB 487).
* **Economic Development:** Property Tax Exemption for Indoor Farming Equipment (SB 483) and**** Casino Host Cities (SB 628)

While the following bills were put off for the year I look forward to fighting further for these during the 2025 session once we’ve had an opportunity to make recommended changes:
* **Criminal Justice Reform:** Abolition of Fines and Fees for Juvenile Offenders (SB 481); Expungement and Sealing of Juvenile Court Records (SB 482) and Failure to Appear Reform (SB 643).

---
| | |
---
| |
---
|
#
**Budget Overview**

---
| | On Sunday, February 18, the Senate and House released their respective budget proposals. In addition to our legislation, the budget is the strongest indicator of our values and priorities for our communities and families. For starters, the Senate budget removes Governor Youngkin’s regressive income and sales tax proposals that would have burdened working Virginians while rewarding billionaires. This course correction allowed the Senate budget to structure their big investments towards education–both K-12 and Higher Education–to ensure our schools are modernized, our teachers see salary increases and funding to improve the overall quality and operations of our schools. In addition, 1.2 billion is proposed to fund our medicaid program, state employee raises and nearly 130 million will support mental health resources. There has been a lot of discussion regarding the proposed arena, but the Senate budget does not include a funding proposal for this. It does however also include funding to raise the minimum wage to $15 an hour, state rental assistance program funding, increases for safer communities program and PFAS monitoring system funding. Furthermore, the following budget amendments of ours were included:
* [Maintain Eligibility for Hate Crime Grants ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79906304/457864153/-1523011563?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTAxOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1Yzc1NjQ5OS01NmQ2LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=W3Dv2EvIYHdpv2qd0BlDlqHO2QbUJwHTmAvj92rQEN0=&emci=e8e017b8-d6d4-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=5c756499-56d6-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=29045629)\- Opens Grant Funding to Nonprofits and Institutions combating hate crimes within the community.

**Launch of Black Maternal Health Caucus**

---
| | On Valentine’s Day, for the love of Black mothers–I proudly joined co-chairs Sen. Angelia Williams Graves, Dels. Candi Mundon King and Delores McQuinn for the launch of the Black Maternal Health Caucus. Since 2018 I’ve worked with members like Del. Marcia Price to combat the maternal mortality crisis in our Commonwealth, with policy reforms, funding and advocacy. But data shows we are still experiencing unacceptable rates of infant and maternal mortality. Our caucus will build on previous efforts with increased collaboration between policymakers, physicians, providers and advocates. Together it is our goal to work towards a future where every mother can look forward to childbirth with hope and excitement and not fear.

clean_body: | | | | | We began the 2024 General Assembly session with legislators introducing 2,816 bills and resolutions. Moving at a rapid pace, committees have been meeting to deliberate these introduced policies, sometimes altering their initial concepts before advancing in the legislative process or sending the patron to continue their work in the interim for next session. February 13, was the deadline for the House and Senate to complete action on those bills in each respective body. Known as “crossover” only 1,341 bills survived and remained for us to act on over the next three weeks. | | | ---|---|--- | | | | Crossover Update | | We were no exception to the legislative process and while we began the session with a full agenda of 21 bills, we’ve since had bills pass, incorporated into other bills, and even failed to advance. We’ve also partnered with other legislators to collaborate on policies that also stand to benefit our district. The status of our agenda is as follows: Education : Community Builders Violence Intervention Pilot Program (SB 484); Community Schools Planning and Implementation Grants (SB 608); Child Social Media Data Protection Act (SB 359) and At-Risk-School Funding (SB 105). Healthcare : Recognizing Black Maternal Health Week (SJ 23) and DMAS LRI Modifications (SB 488). Worker Protections: Overtime for Domestic Workers (SB 494) Community Development & Housing: Enforcement of Landlords by Localities (SB 479); Derelict and Blight Property Tax Enforcement (SB 477) and Vacant Building Registration (SB 48) Consumer Protections: Utility Disconnection Restrictions (SB 480) Environmental : Comprehensive Plans for Healthy Communities Strategy (SB 595) and Electric Vehicle Charging Station Fund (SB 45) Good Governance: Localities in Fiscal Distress, APA Action (SB 645); JLARC Study for Rural Cabinet Secretary (SJ 21) and Artificial Intelligence Regulations and Commission ( SB 487). Economic Development: Property Tax Exemption for Indoor Farming Equipment (SB 483) and** Casino Host Cities (SB 628) While the following bills were put off for the year I look forward to fighting further for these during the 2025 session once we’ve had an opportunity to make recommended changes: Criminal Justice Reform: Abolition of Fines and Fees for Juvenile Offenders (SB 481); Expungement and Sealing of Juvenile Court Records (SB 482) and Failure to Appear Reform (SB 643). | | | | | | Budget Overview | | On Sunday, February 18, the Senate and House released their respective budget proposals. In addition to our legislation, the budget is the strongest indicator of our values and priorities for our communities and families. For starters, the Senate budget removes Governor Youngkin’s regressive income and sales tax proposals that would have burdened working Virginians while rewarding billionaires. This course correction allowed the Senate budget to structure their big investments towards education–both K-12 and Higher Education–to ensure our schools are modernized, our teachers see salary increases and funding to improve the overall quality and operations of our schools. In addition, 1.2 billion is proposed to fund our medicaid program, state employee raises and nearly 130 million will support mental health resources. There has been a lot of discussion regarding the proposed arena, but the Senate budget does not include a funding proposal for this. It does however also include funding to raise the minimum wage to $15 an hour, state rental assistance program funding, increases for safer communities program and PFAS monitoring system funding. Furthermore, the following budget amendments of ours were included: \- Opens Grant Funding to Nonprofits and Institutions combating hate crimes within the community. -This amendment provides $6.2 million GF the first year to provide body-worn cameras to Virginia State Police officers. This amount is estimated to cover 1,200 body-worn cameras. \+ to Implement to support community schools through grants to school divisions to support the development and implementation of community schools initiatives- $1.5m to Implement which** would create a framework by which the Commonwealth can step in to ensure a fiscally distressed locality is able to receive the support it needs to regain its footing financially with targeted management assistance from the State government. \+ to implement SB 487 which provides both protection for individuals within the Commonwealth while allowing for the benefits and advantages of Artificial Intelligence to flourish- $444k –This amendment provides the Department of Environmental Quality (DEQ) the flexibility to apply previously authorized ARPA funds to nutrient reduction and other treatment facility improvements that DEQ would otherwise find acceptable or critical uses. for \- $400k to establish the Community Builders Pilot Program for the purpose of reducing youth involvement in behaviors that lead to gun violence and increasing community engagement among public school students in Roanoke City Public Schools and Petersburg City Public Schools. | | | | Launch of Black Maternal Health Caucus | | On Valentine’s Day, for the love of Black mothers–I proudly joined co-chairs Sen. Angelia Williams Graves, Dels. Candi Mundon King and Delores McQuinn for the launch of the Black Maternal Health Caucus. Since 2018 I’ve worked with members like Del. Marcia Price to combat the maternal mortality crisis in our Commonwealth, with policy reforms, funding and advocacy. But data shows we are still experiencing unacceptable rates of infant and maternal mortality. Our caucus will build on previous efforts with increased collaboration between policymakers, physicians, providers and advocates. Together it is our goal to work towards a future where every mother can look forward to childbirth with hope and excitement and not fear. | | | | What We’re Reading | | Our legislative efforts continue to be covered in the news, take a look at our top 5 most recent articles on the work we’re doing on your behalf: | | | | Legislative Visits | | One of the greatest highlights of the session is advocates, constituents and local leaders visiting us at the General Assembly. Recently, we had the pleasure of the following visits: | | | | Two Final Weeks | | With only two final weeks remaining in the 2024 Session not only are the final decisions we make on policy measures critical but our negotiations to bring the two versions of the budget into one final proposal. I invite you to continue to contact our office with any questions or positions you have on matters before us by email mailto:senatoraird@senate.virginia.gov or by phone at 804-698-7513. For additional resources, you may also visit my website at lashrecseaird.com. [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/15635?t=1055?refcode=email-20240228&akid=5380%2E5885482%2EuEd9eC ]Our Revolution logo

Peter Willis,

Yesterday in Michigan, we defied expectations and scored a major upset in
the state’s Democratic presidential primary!

Over 100,000 people voted Uncommitted to send President Biden a clear
message: The US government’s unconditional support of Netanyahu's war in
Gaza must stop. In Dearborn — home to one of the country’s largest
Arab-American populations — “Uncommitted” even defeated Biden with 56% of
the vote.

Here’s how this happened: Our Revolution mobilized our organizers to call,
text and email our 87,000 supporters in Michigan — and nearly half of
those we spoke with pledged to vote “Uncommitted” to amplify our
collective voice for Peace in this moment.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/15636?t=1098&akid=5380%2E5885482%2EuEd9eC ][IMG]

Bottom line: Our Revolution went all-in to turn-out our progressive base
to make Michigan a megaphone for Peace — and by doing so, we delivered an
electoral wake-up call that the President cannot ignore. The results in
Michigan show that in order for Democrats to defeat Donald Trump in
November, Biden must realign his foreign policy with the demands of his
voter base and stop ignoring the progressive Pro-Peace voting bloc that is
emerging to challenge him on Gaza.

While we’ve won, our work is not yet done. We have to keep up the pressure
on President Biden. We have to ramp up our GOTV efforts ahead of next
Tuesday to send another message for Peace by getting out the vote in the
California primary for Barbara Lee, the only Peace candidate in the
California U.S. Senate primary. And we must gear up to defend against
AIPAC’s $100,000,000 in attack ads aimed at progressives for speaking out
for Palestinian human rights.

ahead? We need your grassroots support NOW to elect Barbara Lee, combat
AIPAC attack ads, and keep fighting for Peace. Help us reach our goal to
raise $6,327 before the end of this month!

If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation to Our Revolution will process immediately.

U.S. Rep. Pramila Jayapal offered advice to President Biden as the
“Uncommitted” vote came in last night: “The war on Gaza is a deep moral
issue and the lack of attention and empathy for this perspective from the
administration is breaking apart the fragile coalition we built to elect
Joe Biden in 2020.”

Former Rep. Andy Levin spoke of the people power of Our Revolution, who
came together with our allies to lift “Uncommitted” to over 100,000 votes
in under three weeks of organizing.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/15636?t=1096&akid=5380%2E5885482%2EuEd9eC ][IMG]

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/15636?t=1097&akid=5380%2E5885482%2EuEd9eC ]FUEL OUR ORGANIZING

Our next chance to vote for Peace is on Tuesday, the last day of voting
for Barbara Lee in California’s U.S. Senate primary. The other Democrats
are busy spending money boosting Republicans in the race because they’re
afraid to face Barbara and her message of Peace.

And we’ve got to defend Progressive champions like Rashida Tlaib, Pramila
Jayapal, and Ilhan Omar — who have bravely spoken out against Israeli war
crimes in Gaza — from AIPAC’s Dark Money attacks.

Peter Willis, we need to
be prepared for the progressive fights ahead this election year. We know
AIPAC, the political establishment, and the war machine won’t stop. But we
also know our movement can defeat big money and the political machine with
your help.

[1]Powered By People

There is something truly inspiring about how Powered by People volunteers
have been stepping up for their fellow Texans in the face of our state’s
failed leadership.

As those in power pass extreme voter suppression and intimidation laws to
keep millions out of our political process, these volunteers have signed
up by the thousands to help their neighbors register to vote and engage in
our elections.

When the power grid failed in 2021, they made over a million calls to
stranded seniors, connecting them with food, water, and warming centers.
They helped raise over $1 million for those whose homes were damaged in
that preventable, man-made disaster.

And when the Texas GOP bungled this state’s Covid response in 2020, our
volunteers stood up food pantries, staffed over 12,000 hours at Texas food
banks, and even made deliveries to those who were out of work and unable
to make ends meet.

Through each of these crises, our state leaders may have failed us, but
these Texans made sure that we wouldn’t fail each other.

Now, as Texas Republicans escalate their attacks on women, on immigrants,
on teachers, and on LGTBQ+ families, Powered by People volunteers are
stepping up for those most targeted by this cruelty and authoritarianism.

With just over eight months to go until the November elections, they’re
spending countless hours knocking on doors to bring as many voters as
possible into the fight to replace those very politicians who are failing
us right now.

Peter — my Finance Director, Taylor, texted me with an important update, and I wanted to share it right away.

Peter, As we prepare for the slew of critical primary elections in March, we must address the issues surrounding mail-in ballots that jeopardize election integrity.
**Fixing the flaws in mail-in ballots is not a matter of opinion; it's a necessity backed by hard data.**
Our analysis reveals alarming discrepancies across states, from delayed ballot counting to potentially invalid signatures. Additionally, the presence of unmonitored drop boxes only exacerbates these concerns, undermining voter confidence and leaving our elections vulnerable to manipulation.

"John McGuire has proven that he's a strong leader, a patriot, and a workhorse. I know he'll do great things of the people for Virginia's 5th District. I also appreciate his hard work on behalf of Republican candidates across Virginia. John has my full support."

Hi there,

I want to share more about my late husband, Grant Woods, and how he inspired my pursuit of public service.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79918034/457896175/-401216107?refcode=em-2.28.24-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYwODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGRkZGY5MDUtNjVkNi1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=b2oJL8s2SNp1kbOKWb-YRvjPCf5hovijQk6RySGuKKU=)
I met Grant in 1988 when I moved to Arizona to work at Channel 12. A friend asked to set me up on a blind date with a Republican. After covering the GOP convention as a reporter, I was nervous, to say the least.

Before I agreed, I asked if he was at least pro-choice. He was so I said yes. He was also hilarious, and brilliant and irreverent. Best blind date ever. The rest, as they say, is history.

Service was Grant’s guiding light and he was elected Attorney General of Arizona in 1990. Arizona was his home. He was committed to justice and believed it was his responsibility to “look out for the little guy”. That's why he went to law school to begin with, and it's why he was such a dynamic Attorney General for our state - always putting country over party and people over politics.

You can only imagine how much the kids and I have missed Grant these last 2 years. Some days the grief still takes my breath away. But here’s what I do know: I am who I am today because of him. I’m proud of his fearless voice, his impassioned work and his legacy to make our state and our country better. As I continue my campaign to serve Arizona, I am filled with comfort and strength knowing I carry with me his lessons and passion for public service.

[**I hope to inspire this community the way my husband did by putting service to Arizonans at the center of everything we do. That's what our community deserves, and if you’re with me, please consider making a $3 donation today.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79918035/457896176/-401216107?refcode=em-2.28.24-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYwODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGRkZGY5MDUtNjVkNi1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=b2oJL8s2SNp1kbOKWb-YRvjPCf5hovijQk6RySGuKKU=)

Thank you,

Marlene

clean_body: | = Hi there, I want to share more about my late husband, Grant Woods, and how he inspired my pursuit of public service. = I met Grant in 1988 when I moved to Arizona to work at Channel 12. A friend asked to set me up on a blind date with a Republican. After covering the GOP convention as a reporter, I was nervous, to say the least. Before I agreed, I asked if he was at least pro-choice. He was so I said yes. He was also hilarious, and brilliant and irreverent. Best blind date ever. The rest, as they say, is history. Service was Grant’s guiding light and he was elected Attorney General of Arizona in 1990. Arizona was his home. He was committed to justice and believed it was his responsibility to “look out for the little guy”. That's why he went to law school to begin with, and it's why he was such a dynamic Attorney General for our state - always putting country over party and people over politics. You can only imagine how much the kids and I have missed Grant these last 2 years. Some days the grief still takes my breath away. But here’s what I do know: I am who I am today because of him. I’m proud of his fearless voice, his impassioned work and his legacy to make our state and our country better. As I continue my campaign to serve Arizona, I am filled with comfort and strength knowing I carry with me his lessons and passion for public service. = Thank you, Marlene | **=** | Marlene's campaign to flip AZ-01 is being built from the ground up with grassroots support! = To learn more about Marlene and how she's fighting for Arizona families, please visit: We'd hate to see you go, but you can click here if you'd like to . https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

Corporations are doing everything possible to stem the tide of union organizing among their workers. Now, that includes patently false legal claims [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/02/15/business/economy/amazon-labor-nlrb.html] by Amazon, SpaceX, and Trader Joe’s that the National Labor Relations Board (NLRB), America’s leading labor law enforcement agency, is unconstitutional.

The NLRB ensures workers have the protections they need to organize and engage in collective action. It supports workers facing unfair, often retaliatory labor practices from major corporations as they attempt to unionize. Without it, workers would have no seat at the table.

https://twitter.com/RoKhanna/status/1760077941969399931?s=20 [https://twitter.com/RoKhanna/status/1760077941969399931?s=20]

We need to step up and stand with workers who choose to form unions, ensure that corporations allow free and fair union elections and demand that union workers are not retaliated against by Big Business.

Sign if you agree: Congress must take action to protect workers’ rights. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/pro-act-unions]

If we want to do right by workers, we must give them the tools they need to succeed. We can start by demanding that the Senate pass the Protecting the Right to Organize (PRO) Act. Introduced by Senator Bernie Sanders, this bill is designed to strengthen collective bargaining rights and hold corporations accountable for violating workers' rights.

Strong unions mean a strong middle class and a stronger economy overall. They mean fair wages, improved benefits, and better working conditions for everyone. That’s why the fight for workers to unionize matters so much, and why we need to protect and support these unionization efforts.

Sign the petition and tell Congress to pass the PRO Act and strengthen workers’ rights! [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/pro-act-unions]

ADD YOUR NAME [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/pro-act-unions]

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

Onward,
Ro

After the Respect for Marriage Act was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law

|

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyMkU1r3DAQQH-NfLPR19rWwYcl24VSUkIvPQp5POuI6MOM5Jb8--LU6bnXmTcPHvPz2T47H3xav7uI0xuQpWKTsw58Sxj82padfuG7lVzqlstWjlY0y7QY6F3f4CQGboQetBmb18nM4yCGGZyZuVGLAXcBruRitFKPQUPjp8PDpRzFKEYlup4P_UML5fiMFz5emOYuINXuDXGDnFbCUgi3fQ4eXOogxyZMr7Vuhakrk3cm7_nxQCqdi0gHA5kSUqk5YZdpZfL-EeLzXtrgZ6T6fkYd5-q-12jBxc35NTF1-wef7CfaH1zJOwEyddsolw2h-rSeq4iL3yNTN4zOh3MIOVVMlanby7X99vSj_cxnsv_rspCXQ3h9-ioV119eOBcNTcv224fgSz8wzdfD-JFe__dFfwIAAP__jceccQ) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyMkU1r3DAQQH-NfLPR19rWwYcl24VSUkIvPQp5POuI6MOM5Jb8--LU6bnXmTcPHvPz2T47H3xav7uI0xuQpWKTsw58Sxj82padfuG7lVzqlstWjlY0y7QY6F3f4CQGboQetBmb18nM4yCGGZyZuVGLAXcBruRitFKPQUPjp8PDpRzFKEYlup4P_UML5fiMFz5emOYuINXuDXGDnFbCUgi3fQ4eXOogxyZMr7Vuhakrk3cm7_nxQCqdi0gHA5kSUqk5YZdpZfL-EeLzXtrgZ6T6fkYd5-q-12jBxc35NTF1-wef7CfaH1zJOwEyddsolw2h-rSeq4iL3yNTN4zOh3MIOVVMlanby7X99vSj_cxnsv_rspCXQ3h9-ioV119eOBcNTcv224fgSz8wzdfD-JFe__dFfwIAAP__jceccQ)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyMkU1r3DAQQH-NfLPR19rWwYcl24VSUkIvPQp5POuI6MOM5Jb8--LU6bnXmTcPHvPz2T47H3xav7uI0xuQpWKTsw58Sxj82padfuG7lVzqlstWjlY0y7QY6F3f4CQGboQetBmb18nM4yCGGZyZuVGLAXcBruRitFKPQUPjp8PDpRzFKEYlup4P_UML5fiMFz5emOYuINXuDXGDnFbCUgi3fQ4eXOogxyZMr7Vuhakrk3cm7_nxQCqdi0gHA5kSUqk5YZdpZfL-EeLzXtrgZ6T6fkYd5-q-12jBxc35NTF1-wef7CfaH1zJOwEyddsolw2h-rSeq4iL3yNTN4zOh3MIOVVMlanby7X99vSj_cxnsv_rspCXQ3h9-ioV119eOBcNTcv224fgSz8wzdfD-JFe__dFfwIAAP__jceccQ)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

If you have the time to keep reading, I hope that you'll take a moment to celebrate our recent wins.
In 2023, we really got to work. I introduced legislation to create a national paid leave program — legislation that I first introduced 10 years ago, and have continued to advocate for since then. You immediately rallied behind me, voicing your support for this long-overdue legislation. **And today, support for paid family leave is higher than ever before** — including 85% of all voters in battleground states! Thank you for making this possible.
I also**released my Strategic Plan on Aging to make sure that our seniors can retire with dignity and financial stability.** From expanding existing programs like Medicare to helping more seniors remain in their homes, these proposals would drastically improve the quality of life for millions of seniors. Thank you for supporting my work to make this happen.
I'm also incredibly grateful for the outpouring of support from this grassroots team after **I introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment.****** This amendment would establish protections against gender-based discrimination in our constitution, once and for all, giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. Activists have been fighting for the ERA for 100 years, and it is truly an honor to carry forward their work today. Thank you for standing beside me in the fight for gender equity and reproductive freedom.
Lastly, I fought tirelessly to make sure that the National Defense Authorization Act included a pay increase for service members, investments to clean up toxic PFAS contamination and funding for hundreds of spots in my brand-new cyber security academy at over 400 schools. Thank you for helping me ensure that our veterans and service members get the benefits they deserve.

There have been so many other moments when you've stood beside me, and I am grateful for every single one of them. But our fight for progress is far from over. And now, Democrats are in the most difficult election years in recent memory.
Here in New York, Republicans just had their best election cycle in years. Now, they're directly targeting my seat. With a narrow 51-49 majority, we cannot afford to show any signs of weakness. **Missing this end-of-month goal would be sending a crystal clear message to the GOP that this seat is up for grabs.****[_So please, will you donate $5 or whatever you can spare before 11:59 p.m. to help me continue our fight for progress in this year? But in case you're short on time, I have to make sure that you see this first: My end-of-month deadline is less than 36 hours away, and we're still pacing dangerously short of my $100,000 goal.= | | = If you have the time to keep reading, I hope that you'll take a moment to celebrate our recent wins. In 2023, we really got to work. I introduced legislation to create a national paid leave program — legislation that I first introduced 10 years ago, and have continued to advocate for since then. You immediately rallied behind me, voicing your support for this long-overdue legislation. And today, support for paid family leave is higher than ever before — including 85% of all voters in battleground states! Thank you for making this possible. I alsoreleased my Strategic Plan on Aging to make sure that our seniors can retire with dignity and financial stability. From expanding existing programs like Medicare to helping more seniors remain in their homes, these proposals would drastically improve the quality of life for millions of seniors. Thank you for supporting my work to make this happen. I'm also incredibly grateful for the outpouring of support from this grassroots team after I introduced a resolution to finally certify the Equal Rights Amendment.** This amendment would establish protections against gender-based discrimination in our constitution, once and for all, giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. Activists have been fighting for the ERA for 100 years, and it is truly an honor to carry forward their work today. Thank you for standing beside me in the fight for gender equity and reproductive freedom. Lastly, I fought tirelessly to make sure that the National Defense Authorization Act included a pay increase for service members, investments to clean up toxic PFAS contamination and funding for hundreds of spots in my brand-new cyber security academy at over 400 schools. Thank you for helping me ensure that our veterans and service members get the benefits they deserve. There have been so many other moments when you've stood beside me, and I am grateful for every single one of them. But our fight for progress is far from over. Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c3931531307245a09f8324fe70925663&_e=mTEzkSRL8QrOWuP_kwDveuHDpYXS8itbAEtLZOUaD6P-3CBJVbtPkGG3ud43UUFT_QLrclSbJShXwnRJWBv8FTcwq4eGas43wGDw0Q00KRFatfEjg6m-7EG1oWJvf33TfQaCAnEuE9cHjIeUaV77AjvOJ-xo4boZJyrZVNrWYboCVFqj9VC1108nvNmGgr8I9XRm3mofpE3oZtwLiH61mARrIRpApPVNybcs2rxo3kzgO4Nl89Crb3_o7xPaFy1a8B_jOv2EIrKBUPf_ShdkyL2_JB4dzSac6E3E16jFzfTCmj-t_EvExO9B80Ip-4eA0laoU_p2QVXJjlSBl_2ZAG6gpXSUdJVa7tYIIQs7o4O-W3vrwd54nmNr-Vra1od38DbZ09wPkbyT7vRy4Wuu-w%3D%3D)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

Peter, we'll be rolling out our 2024 endorsements soon, but we just couldn't wait to tell you about one of the incredible candidates we're working with this cycle:
**Mo Jenkins, Democratic candidate for House District 139 (Houston), is on the ballot this Tuesday in the Texas primary.** We’re doing everything possible to ensure she advances to the runoff election. And if she wins again in November, **Mo Jenkins would be the first Black Trans woman elected to the Texas House.**
**[Peter, we're racing to meet our $50,000 end-of-month fundraising goal to help get Mo across the finish line on Tuesday. Will you make an urgent donation today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240228-1?refcode=em20240228-1&amount=5&refcode2=425_587540_4TWrPc&akid=425%2E587540%2E4TWrPc)**

We are so excited about this race. Mo’s campaign is a major opportunity to change the face of power and elect the kind of young, progressive leader Texas needs. Especially as so many LGBT people across the country are under attack. We see it as more important than ever that young trans people see there is someone with their experience fighting for them in government.
Mo is exactly the kind of candidate we had in mind when we founded Leaders We Deserve last year: bold, courageous, and ready to shake the status quo to its core.
But we’re running out of time to ensure she wins her primary election.
**That’s why we’re working around the clock to make sure we hit our $50,000 fundraising goal before the February deadline. Every donation from supporters like you helps us elect inspiring progressives like Mo Jenkins all across the country.**

# **[Kellogg's CEO Faces Backlash Over Comments](http://trk.libertyledger._c2V5aWQ9MTIxNTIyIn0/nttQiVOL0DcravBPefiPYQ)**
---
