| | Hi Peter,

We're still celebrating the results of this month's special election – _**despite the GOP pouring millions into the race, they lost their hold on NY-03 when Democrats flipped the seat. **_

This is a big win that sends a much stronger message to campaigns like ours: **flipping these seats is possible.**

We're not exaggerating when we say this: _**John James is anti-choice, anti-safety and pro-party when he should be pro-people, and he isn't the right one to stand up for MI-10 in Congress.**_

Now, as we get closer to a Republican-led government shutdown, people in our district are even less confident GOP candidates can be strong actors for change in our communities.

Emily Busch is a mom and member of the community running to unseat him and be the loud and unapologetic voice our community needs to fight for what is right.

| | | Emily first learned the importance of community and helping others from her mom, a nurse, and dad, a manufacturing representative, while growing up in a tight-knit, middle-class Midwestern family.

name: Moore HQ
subject: New economic opportunity in Maryland
body:
Friend,

Every Marylander deserves to do more than just survive. They deserve to thrive, not just themselves, but their families and neighborhoods as well.
To do that, that requires us to invest in Marylanders — and bring more opportunities to our state.

Wes is working to do just that. Last week, Wes announced $10 million for small business grants. Not only will this allow more folks to start small businesses, but it’ll strengthen local economies by reinvigorating vast areas of the states.

The Governor also announced the Department of Commerce will create incentives to support almost 10,000 jobs in Maryland. These new incentives will retain current talent in the state, add new jobs, and provide resources for workforce training programs.

Economic opportunity should not only be accessible to a select few. No one knows this better than Wes, who understands firsthand the struggles many Maryland families face and has made creating economic opportunity the central mission driving his work as Governor. He believes that no matter where you start in life, you deserve an equal opportunity to succeed.

With Wes’ leadership, we know we have a Governor who will fight to increase opportunities for economic growth for all.

Thank you for your support,
Team Moore

subject: Republicans are not “pro-life.” They just want to control women’s bodies.
body:
|
#
Peter, Despite what they may tell you, Republicans are not “pro-life.” They simply want to control women’s bodies. Let me explain what I mean. We all know that Republicans are focused on banning abortion nationwide. But last week, after the Alabama Supreme Court effectively banned IVF procedures in the state — which _help_ couples start families — Republicans suddenly recoiled. **National Republicans, realizing how deeply radical and unpopular this ruling would be, even for _them_ , told its members to speak out against it. ** But we can’t be fooled by their sudden change of tone. Dozens of MAGA Republicans _had already_ co-sponsored bills that ban IVF therapy! One of these Republicans even said on a television interview Sunday that the country needs access to IVF because it helps “breed great families.” **This is just gross, Peter. Republicans don’t care about “life,” they only care about controlling women’s bodies and freedoms. And if they retake the Senate majority, it’s only a matter of time before they pass a nationwide abortion ban.** **[So please, pitch in $10 or more to protect my seat, defend our pro-choice Democratic majority, and keep me fighting for reproductive freedom. clean_body: | Peter, Despite what they may tell you, Republicans are not “pro-life.” They simply want to control women’s bodies. Let me explain what I mean. We all know that Republicans are focused on banning abortion nationwide. But last week, after the Alabama Supreme Court effectively banned IVF procedures in the state — which help couples start families — Republicans suddenly recoiled. National Republicans, realizing how deeply radical and unpopular this ruling would be, even for them , told its members to speak out against it. But we can’t be fooled by their sudden change of tone. Dozens of MAGA Republicans had already co-sponsored bills that ban IVF therapy! One of these Republicans even said on a television interview Sunday that the country needs access to IVF because it helps “breed great families.” This is just gross, Peter. Republicans don’t care about “life,” they only care about controlling women’s bodies and freedoms. clean_body: President Biden was hoping you might be able to help. | | | Peter, Our campaign has a bit of a problem on our hands -- and with only a few hours to go before our FEC fundraising deadline ends, President Biden was hoping you might be able to help. The good news is , we have far more individual donations to our campaign this month than in the last few months. The President is very proud of that fact, and you should be too. The bad news is that our average donation in the last week has slipped by about $5. That's OK -- this campaign is all about people giving whatever they can afford at the moment. No donation is too small. But what it means is that in order to hit our goals before our deadline, we either need more donations, or we need people to give a little bit more. Normally we ask someone making their first online donation to give just $10. Today, we have to ask you to do a little bit more, Peter. Especially with Trump having all but locked up the Republican nomination. | If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | Thank you in advance for contributing before this midnight deadline. _Jesse James shakes hands with Dakota, a candidate for Montana State House District 1._
_**Leap year is giving us an extra day to meet our goal**_!
_First, the Good News:_ 15 percent more donors gave to this campaign to take our Montana back than in January.
We’re reaching out further and contacting more voters every single day to earn your support and win this election.
_The less good news_ is while many more gave, not everyone has the means to give at the same level, and the amount raised is down 25% versus January.
But the creators of our funky calendar gave us an extra day every fourth February, and we’re hoping this one will help us make our fundraising goal so we can stay on the road, talking to Montana voters about why we need a Secretary of State who believes more in our constitution than MAGA!
Giving more makes a big difference, but donations of [$1, $2, or $5](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=71a1d00ec6&e=805e709ff8) make a huge impact, too! | [H.B. 215](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_b6Kj94akUH6XcVc8P72fpL8ZYcfl-v3QJ2wCC2cYsbD6EbItXBMbMhB76BbiDy2f_lpm0rlQRRHxkDG6ytA3WKhBx5IMlD95VjSlYQKxlcJoGfDmQrA5_NvUatV_dJDndQmILq0ODJV1GZjqv_XBb50dK02ozwGWQjjZ2izZqGN91pRfYqOWFlNyxhSArXRlMWITzxDpA=&c=5AcbeuFZN7DqOlmUXXbTMh9BEjWnbR1dAbHcZgKEzn6mkcm9VeWo1w==&ch=mPQbFafruDRffnvGBFDY0W05Yy8OylfZ1iNd2av3dyJ3_WDEpyVr7g==) Patron: Watts Department of Education; development of Title IX and sexual harassment prevention training modules for high school students. Requires the Department of Education to develop culturally appropriate, age-appropriate, and trauma-informed Title IX and sexual harassment prevention training modules concerning Title IX rights and protections, consent, and sexual harassment prevention and reporting and to make such training modules available to each school board by July 1, 2025, for the education of high school students beginning in the 2025-2026 school year. A BILL to amend the Code of Virginia by adding a section numbered [22.1-23.4](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_b6Kj94akUH6XcVc8P72fpL8ZYcfl-v3QJ2wCC2cYsbD6EbItXBMbMhB76BbiDyoUNpOUCgrUk1CQqEv3c3mdb8_hSCvyfBCvblh6VvOgZwdkU8bBriobrTOcLqmngQR5clIkeZTDP4fJLmTIhDK91akWuIS36E7EMlSC1LOi8=&c=5AcbeuFZN7DqOlmUXXbTMh9BEjWnbR1dAbHcZgKEzn6mkcm9VeWo1w==&ch=mPQbFafruDRffnvGBFDY0W05Yy8OylfZ1iNd2av3dyJ3_WDEpyVr7g==), relating to Department of Education; development of Title IX and sexual harassment prevention training modules for high school students.24101815D
[H.B. 224](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_b6Kj94akUH6XcVc8P72fpL8ZYcfl-v3QJ2wCC2cYsbD6EbItXBMU6FiyKw7RnpsJu9MX7shwff3CCeUV1HaHEjcYxW2lQb3aZrhV6gSwsMKAgwmYoQppVYVE7PHMa_WUF8221l35LATZ29EBAGhOn24nGhSM08wXsBdnnTROtRDuYURdc1B05IkIXpkzF6N6bJO_CsLLY=&c=5AcbeuFZN7DqOlmUXXbTMh9BEjWnbR1dAbHcZgKEzn6mkcm9VeWo1w==&ch=mPQbFafruDRffnvGBFDY0W05Yy8OylfZ1iNd2av3dyJ3_WDEpyVr7g==) Patron: Henson Public schools; teachers and other relevant personnel; mental health awareness training. Requires each teacher and other relevant personnel, as determined by the applicable school board, employed on a full-time basis to complete mental health awareness training that addresses the needs of youth populations that are at a high risk of experiencing mental health challenges and disorders. Current law requires such teachers and personnel to complete mental health awareness training but does not contain any requirements relating to the specific topics such training must address. A BILL to amend and reenact § [22.1-298.6](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_b6Kj94akUH6XcVc8P72fpL8ZYcfl-v3QJ2wCC2cYsbD6EbItXBMU6FiyKw7Rnpz9yYlZwiR0t0EhuwEg7Vm20lNnCtwbB57yRzE118lsHIn49Bzd5LLjHI0BI_iEBqmPRxFBvRImkUDenqY1kLwvuSLKsiXuDo23CRqZPfU4VSdIBsCV3bcA==&c=5AcbeuFZN7DqOlmUXXbTMh9BEjWnbR1dAbHcZgKEzn6mkcm9VeWo1w==&ch=mPQbFafruDRffnvGBFDY0W05Yy8OylfZ1iNd2av3dyJ3_WDEpyVr7g==) of the Code of Virginia, relating to public schools; mental health awareness training and instruction; requirements.24105961D
[H.B. 398](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_b6Kj94akUH6XcVc8P72fpL8ZYcfl-v3QJ2wCC2cYsbD6EbItXBMbMhB76BbiDygT5NTz7t5klJV8BiDY6aEvjU86Q8ere1rmYySDvYIl6FjLKo18WZNequHwojqqcW7_j_xHj_JyZUOroQOAvq5S9J3aqhP6kcHi7bJ12dCJ_zpp5ismGHSXw31CRKd-tWuxDGkn9T62Y=&c=5AcbeuFZN7DqOlmUXXbTMh9BEjWnbR1dAbHcZgKEzn6mkcm9VeWo1w==&ch=mPQbFafruDRffnvGBFDY0W05Yy8OylfZ1iNd2av3dyJ3_WDEpyVr7g==) Patron: McQuinn Public elementary and secondary schools; student discipline; leveled administrative responses to student behavior. Prohibits, except in certain cases involving firearms, drugs, adjudications of delinquency, convictions of certain crimes, or certain aggravating circumstances, any public elementary or secondary school student from being suspended, expelled, or excluded from attendance at school without considering the leveled administrative responses to student behavior, including in-school suspension, as set out in the Department of Education's "Model Guidance for Positive, Preventive Code of Student Conduct Policy and Alternatives to Suspension," and any amendments thereto. A BILL to amend and reenact § [22.1-277](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_b6Kj94akUH6XcVc8P72fpL8ZYcfl-v3QJ2wCC2cYsbD6EbItXBMbMhB76BbiDyuzfqjNJP6MCEMFs4bCAKE-RxK6xhh0zV91Tln2dPtrlmJV-w_PzBv2XXt9a9r35n98Ihysj50cm69dMD3_IaHHSxEe4kxH2g5izfORsqFzM=&c=5AcbeuFZN7DqOlmUXXbTMh9BEjWnbR1dAbHcZgKEzn6mkcm9VeWo1w==&ch=mPQbFafruDRffnvGBFDY0W05Yy8OylfZ1iNd2av3dyJ3_WDEpyVr7g==) of the Code of Virginia, relating to public elementary and secondary schools; student discipline; alternatives to suspension, expulsion, and exclusion.24107237D
[H.B. 426](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_b6Kj94akUH6XcVc8P72fpL8ZYcfl-v3QJ2wCC2cYsbD6EbItXBMbMhB76BbiDyVg26Yk-F45zIlaTpEEPVAQt97grxYwjp9MW0-pU3gsMjDQjfi2GpxfhhrWmyuo3l5DLXIuT2ZdYmu9sILYESMsrUowG7XSyLw9ZPVgS8fZ8cXTWI5sdxYfeXT6PdLGYMEZZSGR9SB1Q=&c=5AcbeuFZN7DqOlmUXXbTMh9BEjWnbR1dAbHcZgKEzn6mkcm9VeWo1w==&ch=mPQbFafruDRffnvGBFDY0W05Yy8OylfZ1iNd2av3dyJ3_WDEpyVr7g==) Patron: Cole Board of Counseling; licensure of professional counselors without examination. Directs the Board of Counseling to develop an examination alternative to licensure for professional counselors. The bill states that such alternative shall allow an applicant to be licensed as a professional counselor if the applicant meets the education, experience, and fitness to practice requirements determined by the Board. A BILL to direct the Board of Counseling to review the regulations for the licensure of professional counselors and develop an examination alternative to licensure that does not conflict with the requirements set forth in the Counseling Compact.24106345D
[H.B. 536](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_b6Kj94akUH6XcVc8P72fpL8ZYcfl-v3QJ2wCC2cYsbD6EbItXBMbMhB76BbiDyaaMTnkPy9XQECBWI96kmSruCyvT4UzmPHXruv93oaohlQhYZ3AWc_TlYdiJgZLvT_NxCDZ3DEKDsDaaT-gLeorrL-9qWDmvc3qkF6OPjfk1Ts0B6NR3EhBLd54u-9xY2oqLts3sosfI=&c=5AcbeuFZN7DqOlmUXXbTMh9BEjWnbR1dAbHcZgKEzn6mkcm9VeWo1w==&ch=mPQbFafruDRffnvGBFDY0W05Yy8OylfZ1iNd2av3dyJ3_WDEpyVr7g==) Patron: Cole Student bullying; definition; characteristics of victim. Adjusts the definition of "bullying" in the context of public education to specify that the real or perceived power imbalance between the aggressor or aggressors and victim that is involved in the act of bullying includes such a power imbalance on the basis of the membership of the victim in a group that is protected from discrimination pursuant to the Virginia Human Rights Act. A BILL to amend and reenact § [22.1-276.01](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_b6Kj94akUH6XcVc8P72fpL8ZYcfl-v3QJ2wCC2cYsbD6EbItXBMbMhB76BbiDyaqcTrBC2pS5GdQouNE4BVr8CCQyc6-IngE6xt4wW1f6YYfBmURhddc-qCeCaMxfRLVcpyEVMbsBitRi6X98wHUAXGVgAlrxDZ8jar3grlVygqarrgUP_RA==&c=5AcbeuFZN7DqOlmUXXbTMh9BEjWnbR1dAbHcZgKEzn6mkcm9VeWo1w==&ch=mPQbFafruDRffnvGBFDY0W05Yy8OylfZ1iNd2av3dyJ3_WDEpyVr7g==) of the Code of Virginia, relating to student bullying; definition; characteristics of victim.24102548D
[H.B. 624](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_b6Kj94akUH6XcVc8P72fpL8ZYcfl-v3QJ2wCC2cYsbD6EbItXBMbMhB76BbiDyMAQ-eVB5F40hVb_cWzaPQegnw_iPJCTO5ewMP-XGiV34O-wWjSKXoG9B6DIxI5Bx5a2H3mcr_5Q9BpUDnqxqyO-_bi5I8FkOLAIxor_gXtGYCTbmwv8UBEl4Swat6fgbRKYBt_jZOrw=&c=5AcbeuFZN7DqOlmUXXbTMh9BEjWnbR1dAbHcZgKEzn6mkcm9VeWo1w==&ch=mPQbFafruDRffnvGBFDY0W05Yy8OylfZ1iNd2av3dyJ3_WDEpyVr7g==) Patron: Rasoul Equity in public school funding; student need; English language learner and at-risk students. Amends Standard of Quality 2 by (i) requiring state funding to be provided to support ratios of instructional positions to English language learner students, based on each such student's English proficiency level, as established in the general appropriation act and (ii) (a) establishing the At-Risk Program for the purpose of supporting programs and services for students who are educationally at risk, including prevention, intervention, or remediation activities required pursuant to Standard 1 (§ [22.1-253.13:1](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_b6Kj94akUH6XcVc8P72fpL8ZYcfl-v3QJ2wCC2cYsbD6EbItXBMbMhB76BbiDyWY_1LRTkBpUY2QEsoKaA1ZwmjonHehxIE7Q_U_sSQzorUSUzGW9cE67UscVivbawlQwwXMpR-YwdYXv9EC0q10wpcoS1GSzfSwGHkvkE7psUunU5_VFbiA==&c=5AcbeuFZN7DqOlmUXXbTMh9BEjWnbR1dAbHcZgKEzn6mkcm9VeWo1w==&ch=mPQbFafruDRffnvGBFDY0W05Yy8OylfZ1iNd2av3dyJ3_WDEpyVr7g==)); teacher recruitment programs and incentives; Dropout Prevention; community and school-based truancy officer programs; Advancement Via Individual Determination (AVID); Project Discovery; programs for English language learners; the hiring of additional school counselors, testing coordinators, and licensed behavior analysts; and programs relating to increasing the success of disadvantaged students in completing a high school degree and providing opportunities to encourage further education and training and (b) requiring a portion of the state funding provided for such At-Risk Program to be allocated to school divisions on a flat per-student percentage rate set out in the general appropriation act and a portion of such funding to be allocated to school divisions on a variable rate set out in the general appropriation act based on the concentration of poverty in the school division. As introduced, the bill was a recommendation of the Joint Legislative Audit and Review Commission. A BILL to amend and reenact §§ [22.1-199.1](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_b6Kj94akUH6XcVc8P72fpL8ZYcfl-v3QJ2wCC2cYsbD6EbItXBMbMhB76BbiDyJ2vdzaZwp1jBTTwzeGDObM3EWK7pBCeNfZcrZrn_3f0lX0FV9n9RsfvxTMJp00nZ9H7bqFICnDPneO2vKeozpyHJAvs-wxGFGU0pjR-_UtyZdB0fQnxJkQ==&c=5AcbeuFZN7DqOlmUXXbTMh9BEjWnbR1dAbHcZgKEzn6mkcm9VeWo1w==&ch=mPQbFafruDRffnvGBFDY0W05Yy8OylfZ1iNd2av3dyJ3_WDEpyVr7g==), [22.1-253.13:2](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_b6Kj94akUH6XcVc8P72fpL8ZYcfl-v3QJ2wCC2cYsbD6EbItXBMbMhB76BbiDyEewAxoS3DZbeF_yHBOe6EsqHOhjavDfO4ZBHZDv5QKfAyRPNxiBnrXWD3xVGkkKXvPBbdyFOZUPDIqXNfvCxifFuG0FNCatnukdenJulcORLRevV0QloYw==&c=5AcbeuFZN7DqOlmUXXbTMh9BEjWnbR1dAbHcZgKEzn6mkcm9VeWo1w==&ch=mPQbFafruDRffnvGBFDY0W05Yy8OylfZ1iNd2av3dyJ3_WDEpyVr7g==), as it shall become effective, and [51.1-617](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_b6Kj94akUH6XcVc8P72fpL8ZYcfl-v3QJ2wCC2cYsbD6EbItXBMbMhB76BbiDyOc1Tyogqp10M5Sm4p3qtAHlhJP7CvM6Vt0RlolZTooCq4uNDwoDlCS-k8pazZPs7VIkKwAqGxjEzykQLg9An_ZpcA_98KfO292LZRv1lYMY=&c=5AcbeuFZN7DqOlmUXXbTMh9BEjWnbR1dAbHcZgKEzn6mkcm9VeWo1w==&ch=mPQbFafruDRffnvGBFDY0W05Yy8OylfZ1iNd2av3dyJ3_WDEpyVr7g==) of the Code of Virginia, relating to public school funding; ratios of instructional positions to English language learner students; At-Risk Program established.24106901D
[H.B. 971](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_b6Kj94akUH6XcVc8P72fpL8ZYcfl-v3QJ2wCC2cYsbD6EbItXBMbMhB76BbiDysPQpG_2gATByp1tJX_FbbX3ag-cWugkVX9vS1g6lylMR8u5LhVVEdMdLTaBlaeFvkE0_GTVVGrFbAqd5CpOQvhzDzRjMqeOMrpam5S0pPulo--JZ_vlbXfooeu8yyENFW3dlDz5Y2vQ=&c=5AcbeuFZN7DqOlmUXXbTMh9BEjWnbR1dAbHcZgKEzn6mkcm9VeWo1w==&ch=mPQbFafruDRffnvGBFDY0W05Yy8OylfZ1iNd2av3dyJ3_WDEpyVr7g==) Patron: Tran Nurse practitioners; autonomous practice. Lowers from five years to three years the amount of full-time clinical experience required before an advanced practice registered nurse may practice without a practice agreement and permits qualified nurse practitioners to attest that a nurse practitioner may be qualified to practice without a practice agreement. The bill permits advanced practice registered nurses to practice without a practice agreement when a patient care team physician is no longer able to serve if such advanced practice registered nurse provides evidence that he meets the requirements to practice without a practice agreement as established by the bill. Finally, the bill requires the Department of Health Professions to collect data on the implementation of the bill and make it publicly available on its website. Allows persons riding a bicycle, electric personal assistive mobility device, electric power-assisted bicycle, moped, or motorized skateboard or scooter to, while remaining in the travel lane, follow the pedestrian control signal corresponding to the person's direction of travel, provided that they travel straight or turn right and yield to pedestrians lawfully in the crosswalk and any vehicle approaching the intersection from the right. A BILL to amend and reenact § [46.2-833](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_b6Kj94akUH6XcVc8P72fpL8ZYcfl-v3QJ2wCC2cYsbD6EbItXBMbMhB76BbiDyfC39Cft-hLmb7uV8yd06eH3ilemB5XFhbtjgcr2B-rxdLjNl_fuZlP24HhkALHPA3YXGLITiFkjYvMW2VGJs1xOISSzm-gP-0OqYwzIMzGs=&c=5AcbeuFZN7DqOlmUXXbTMh9BEjWnbR1dAbHcZgKEzn6mkcm9VeWo1w==&ch=mPQbFafruDRffnvGBFDY0W05Yy8OylfZ1iNd2av3dyJ3_WDEpyVr7g==) of the Code of Virginia, relating to pedestrian control signals; applicability to persons riding bicycles and other devices.24106480D

Authorizes the operator of a bicycle, electric personal assistive mobility device, electric power-assisted bicycle, or motorized skateboard or scooter to yield instead of stop at an intersection controlled by a stop sign if (i) each intersecting highway has no more than three motor vehicle travel lanes; (ii) the operator is at least 15 years of age or accompanied by an adult; (iii) the operator slows to a reasonable speed based on existing conditions; and (iv) before proceeding into the intersection, the person stops for any pedestrian within the crosswalk and to any other vehicle approaching or entering such intersection from another direction. A BILL to amend the Code of Virginia by adding a section numbered [46.2-821.1](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_b6Kj94akUH6XcVc8P72fpL8ZYcfl-v3QJ2wCC2cYsbD6EbItXBMbMhB76BbiDyLtU5stUmsCBhHLFLwVvQine-FnhQuSVIhlOzwhYKc3GAZTKXa66pGcBfH3XDBR01zVqO7k4H0wR3ffRmuyH2yAy0gjSRfYjjjHojQ4_u5RvGTqOyareNYQ==&c=5AcbeuFZN7DqOlmUXXbTMh9BEjWnbR1dAbHcZgKEzn6mkcm9VeWo1w==&ch=mPQbFafruDRffnvGBFDY0W05Yy8OylfZ1iNd2av3dyJ3_WDEpyVr7g==), relating to exception to stopping requirement; bicycle, electric personal assistive mobility device, electric power-assisted bicycle, or motorized skateboard or scooter.24103016D [H.B. 1266](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_b6Kj94akUH6XcVc8P72fpL8ZYcfl-v3QJ2wCC2cYsbD6EbItXBMbMhB76BbiDyXJI_TudGREop2143F1w3zMNTvhp2PN2HHbRDvW3a5vKDk1c-ROlo7PXr4Ej7fY6hK_adTfNI9bzi1pIXqf_q1VDoHZvs4JDXfSBLq0kAat2cMKef4geAS42u9CEL0a2PxG7HAz7q1bM=&c=5AcbeuFZN7DqOlmUXXbTMh9BEjWnbR1dAbHcZgKEzn6mkcm9VeWo1w==&ch=mPQbFafruDRffnvGBFDY0W05Yy8OylfZ1iNd2av3dyJ3_WDEpyVr7g==) Patron: Willett Traffic; bicycles and certain other vehicles. Clarifies the roadways on which bicycles, electric personal assistive mobility devices, electric power-assisted bicycles, motorized skateboards or scooters, or mopeds are exempt from the requirement to ride as close as safely practicable to the right curb from those with a "substandard width lane," defined as too narrow for same-lane passing, to those not wide enough to allow an overtaking motor vehicle to pass as required by law. The bill removes the requirement for persons riding bicycles, electric personal assistive mobility devices, electric power-assisted bicycles, or motorized skateboards or scooters on a highway two abreast to move into a single-file formation and limits the requirement that such persons not impede the normal and reasonable movement of traffic to apply only on roadways with only one travel lane per direction and a posted speed limit of 35 miles per hour or more. A BILL to amend and reenact § == of the Code of Virginia, relating to public schools; mental health awareness training and instruction; requirements.24105961D == Patron: McQuinn Public elementary and secondary schools; student discipline; leveled administrative responses to student behavior. Prohibits, except in certain cases involving firearms, drugs, adjudications of delinquency, convictions of certain crimes, or certain aggravating circumstances, any public elementary or secondary school student from being suspended, expelled, or excluded from attendance at school without considering the leveled administrative responses to student behavior, including in-school suspension, as set out in the Department of Education's "Model Guidance for Positive, Preventive Code of Student Conduct Policy and Alternatives to Suspension," and any amendments thereto. A BILL to amend and reenact § == of the Code of Virginia, relating to public elementary and secondary schools; student discipline; alternatives to suspension, expulsion, and exclusion.24107237D == Patron: Cole Board of Counseling; licensure of professional counselors without examination. Directs the Board of Counseling to develop an examination alternative to licensure for professional counselors. The bill states that such alternative shall allow an applicant to be licensed as a professional counselor if the applicant meets the education, experience, and fitness to practice requirements determined by the Board. A BILL to direct the Board of Counseling to review the regulations for the licensure of professional counselors and develop an examination alternative to licensure that does not conflict with the requirements set forth in the Counseling Compact.24106345D == Patron: Cole Student bullying; definition; characteristics of victim. Adjusts the definition of "bullying" in the context of public education to specify that the real or perceived power imbalance between the aggressor or aggressors and victim that is involved in the act of bullying includes such a power imbalance on the basis of the membership of the victim in a group that is protected from discrimination pursuant to the Virginia Human Rights Act. A BILL to amend and reenact § == of the Code of Virginia, relating to student bullying; definition; characteristics of victim.24102548D == Patron: Rasoul Equity in public school funding; student need; English language learner and at-risk students. Amends Standard of Quality 2 by (i) requiring state funding to be provided to support ratios of instructional positions to English language learner students, based on each such student's English proficiency level, as established in the general appropriation act and (ii) (a) establishing the At-Risk Program for the purpose of supporting programs and services for students who are educationally at risk, including prevention, intervention, or remediation activities required pursuant to Standard 1 (§ ==); teacher recruitment programs and incentives; Dropout Prevention; community and school-based truancy officer programs; Advancement Via Individual Determination (AVID); Project Discovery; programs for English language learners; the hiring of additional school counselors, testing coordinators, and licensed behavior analysts; and programs relating to increasing the success of disadvantaged students in completing a high school degree and providing opportunities to encourage further education and training and (b) requiring a portion of the state funding provided for such At-Risk Program to be allocated to school divisions on a flat per-student percentage rate set out in the general appropriation act and a portion of such funding to be allocated to school divisions on a variable rate set out in the general appropriation act based on the concentration of poverty in the school division. As introduced, the bill was a recommendation of the Joint Legislative Audit and Review Commission. A BILL to amend and reenact §§ ==, ==, as it shall become effective, and == of the Code of Virginia, relating to public school funding; ratios of instructional positions to English language learner students; At-Risk Program established.24106901D == Patron: Tran Nurse practitioners; autonomous practice. Lowers from five years to three years the amount of full-time clinical experience required before an advanced practice registered nurse may practice without a practice agreement and permits qualified nurse practitioners to attest that a nurse practitioner may be qualified to practice without a practice agreement. The bill permits advanced practice registered nurses to practice without a practice agreement when a patient care team physician is no longer able to serve if such advanced practice registered nurse provides evidence that he meets the requirements to practice without a practice agreement as established by the bill. Finally, the bill requires the Department of Health Professions to collect data on the implementation of the bill and make it publicly available on its website. A BILL to amend and reenact § == of the Code of Virginia, relating to nurse practitioners; patient care team provider; autonomous practice.24107300D == Patron: Tran Institutions of higher education; students who report act of hazing or bullying experienced as result of report of act of hazing; on-campus mental and behavioral health support. Requires each public institution of higher education and nonprofit private institution of higher education to provide information about on-campus individuals or entities that are qualified to provide the appropriate ongoing mental and behavioral health support to any student who reports to the institution an act of hazing or an act of bullying experienced as the result of a report of an act of hazing. A BILL to amend and reenact §§ == and == of the Code of Virginia, relating to institutions of higher education; students who report act of hazing or bullying experienced as result of report of act of hazing; information about on-campus mental and behavioral health support.24106343D | | == | not meeting | | == | House Bills on Third Reading - Regular Calendar .. == == == == == == == == == == Bills in Conference ... == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == == * == | | == | == Patron: Sullivan Pedestrian control signals; applicability to persons riding bicycles and other devices. Allows persons riding a bicycle, electric personal assistive mobility device, electric power-assisted bicycle, moped, or motorized skateboard or scooter to, while remaining in the travel lane, follow the pedestrian control signal corresponding to the person's direction of travel, provided that they travel straight or turn right and yield to pedestrians lawfully in the crosswalk and any vehicle approaching the intersection from the right. A BILL to amend and reenact § == of the Code of Virginia, relating to pedestrian control signals; applicability to persons riding bicycles and other devices.24106480D == Patron: Carr Exception to stopping requirement; bicycle, electric personal assistive mobility device, electric power-assisted bicycle, or motorized skateboard or scooter. Authorizes the operator of a bicycle, electric personal assistive mobility device, electric power-assisted bicycle, or motorized skateboard or scooter to yield instead of stop at an intersection controlled by a stop sign if (i) each intersecting highway has no more than three motor vehicle travel lanes; (ii) the operator is at least 15 years of age or accompanied by an adult; (iii) the operator slows to a reasonable speed based on existing conditions; and (iv) before proceeding into the intersection, the person stops for any pedestrian within the crosswalk and to any other vehicle approaching or entering such intersection from another direction. A BILL to amend the Code of Virginia by adding a section numbered ==, relating to exception to stopping requirement; bicycle, electric personal assistive mobility device, electric power-assisted bicycle, or motorized skateboard or scooter.24103016D == Patron: Willett Traffic; bicycles and certain other vehicles. Clarifies the roadways on which bicycles, electric personal assistive mobility devices, electric power-assisted bicycles, motorized skateboards or scooters, or mopeds are exempt from the requirement to ride as close as safely practicable to the right curb from those with a "substandard width lane," defined as too narrow for same-lane passing, to those not wide enough to allow an overtaking motor vehicle to pass as required by law. The bill removes the requirement for persons riding bicycles, electric personal assistive mobility devices, electric power-assisted bicycles, or motorized skateboards or scooters on a highway two abreast to move into a single-file formation and limits the requirement that such persons not impede the normal and reasonable movement of traffic to apply only on roadways with only one travel lane per direction and a posted speed limit of 35 miles per hour or more. A BILL to amend and reenact § == the Code of Virginia, relating to regulation of traffic; bicycles and certain other vehicles.24106977D | == | not meeting | | == | not meeting | | == | not meeting | | == | == Patron: Seibold Earned sentence credits; incarceration prior to entry of final order of conviction. Provides that any period of incarceration in any correctional facility for which a person was held on the charge of conviction, including any period of incarceration prior to conviction, shall be used in calculating such person's earned sentence credits. A BILL to amend and reenact § == of the Code of Virginia, relating to earned sentence credits; incarceration prior to entry of final order of conviction.24101920D == Patron: Sullivan Electric Vehicle Rural Infrastructure Program and Fund created. Creates the Electric Vehicle Rural Infrastructure Program and Fund to assist private developers with non-utility costs associated with the installation of public electric vehicle charging stations in certain localities. The bill provides that a private developer is eligible to receive grants of 70 percent of such non-utility costs for public electric vehicle charging stations installed in a city or county that meets the criteria of a distressed locality, as defined in the bill. The bill has an expiration date of July 1, 2028. A BILL to amend the Code of Virginia by adding in Chapter 17 of Title 45.2 an article numbered 10, consisting of sections numbered ==, ==, and ==, relating to Electric Vehicle Rural Infrastructure Program and Fund created.24101049D == Patron: Askew Collective bargaining by firefighters and emergency medical services providers. Authorizes firefighters and emergency medical services providers employed by a political subdivision of the Commonwealth to engage in collective bargaining through labor organizations or other designated representatives. The bill provides for the appointment of a three-member board of arbitration regarding any dispute arising between an employer and firefighters or emergency services. Under the bill, determinations made by such board of arbitration are final on a disputed issue and are binding on the parties involved. | _Our friend Harry Dunn is running for Congress in Maryland’s Third District.**_I hope you’ll read the message below from him and consider splitting a donation between Harry’s campaign and Fight for Reform._**_
---
Hey there team,

I just launched my merch store last week and I've already run into a bit of a problem.

It's a good problem to have, but here's the deal: **yard signs are in super high demand, but they're also super expensive to make.**

Yard signs are one of the best ways to get your name out there and with a primary this crowded, I need to paint the town Harry!
So I'm wondering if you can chip in $16 (the amount it takes to make a yard sign) so I can make sure Maryland's 3rd district is covered corner to corner with Dunn for Congress! [**Will you split a donation between Fight for Reform and our Yard Sign Fund?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/38444?t=7&akid=20886%2E4449941%2EGUZxyX)
[Sponsor a Yard Sign: Chip in $16 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/38444?t=8&akid=20886%2E4449941%2EGUZxyX)
---
Like I said, this primary is really crowded – there's 22 candidates in the running!

And as silly as it may sound, a yard sign could encourage a voter to look me up.

They'd find out that I'm a Maryland native, a girl dad, and a former Capitol police officer who defended the Capitol and everyone in it with my bare hands on January 6. They'd find out I support abortion rights, voting rights and defending our country from far-right extremism.

And maybe, (hopefully), they'd vote for me, or chip in to my campaign. Maybe they'd even buy a yard sign to support me!
[**So, can I count on you to split $16 between my campaign so I can restock my yard signs and Fight for Reform to help them elect state and local Democrats? I'm so appreciative of anything you can give!**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/38444?t=9&akid=20886%2E4449941%2EGUZxyX)

body:
| | | | | |
---
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=4323d15034&e=0a12281e0e)
# Urgent: Help Us Secure Victory in the May 14th Primary! 🇺🇸
Dear Fellow Republican,
As a valued member of the Republican family, we are reaching out to you today with an urgent plea for support. The Roca for Congress campaign is at a critical juncture, and we need your help to secure victory in the upcoming primary election on May 14th for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District.
With absentee ballots set to be mailed out by the state of Maryland starting on March 29th, we are facing a tight deadline to ensure our message reaches every voter in our district. To make this happen, we must raise $20,000 by March 15th in order to get our materials out in time.
Your contribution today will play a crucial role in funding our outreach efforts, including mailers, text messages, phone calls, and postcards. These channels are vital in engaging voters and highlighting the principles that our Republican candidate, Mariela Roca, stands for.
Here's how your support can make a difference:
1. **Mailers** : By investing in mailers, we can deliver a tangible and persuasive message directly to voters' mailboxes, ensuring they are well-informed about our Mariela’s vision for our community.
2. **Text Campaigns** : Mobile communication is key in reaching a diverse audience. Your contribution will help us implement a robust text messaging campaign to connect with voters on a personal level and address their concerns.
3. **Phone Calls** : Personalized phone calls remain one of the most effective ways to engage voters. Your support will enable us to make targeted calls, sharing our candidate's platform and answering questions directly.
4. **Postcards** : Postcards offer a personal touch, allowing us to reach voters in a memorable and impactful way. Your contribution will help us design and distribute postcards that resonate with voters and reinforce Mariela’s message.

We understand that these are challenging times, but the future of our district and country is at stake.
Every dollar you contribute will bring us one step closer to ensuring a Republican victory in November for Maryland 6th, one of the most crucial races in the country that can decide our House Majortiy!
Please click on the link below to make your secure contribution:
[**rocaforcongress.com/donate**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=81e9c7c139&e=0a12281e0e)
Thank you for standing with us in this pivotal moment.
Let's not forget the bigger picture: the future of our Republican majority in the House of Representatives hangs in the balance. We cannot afford to lose sight of the importance of securing seats like Maryland's 6th Congressional District if we want to keep a Republican majority in the House of Representatives and continue advancing our conservative agenda.
Sincerely,
MichaelCampaign Fundraising ChairRoca for Congress Campaign
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=a2a4dfc923&e=0a12281e0e)
|
---
# More about Mariela Roca
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=dffc4d3ed0&e=0a12281e0e)
My name is Mariela Roca. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for Congress here in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District.
[**Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum and WIN BACK Maryland’s 6th Congressional District!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=621b3e1178&e=0a12281e0e)
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=2895116087&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress because I was raised by a single mom in Puerto Rico who always showed me how hard work and determination is what makes us all live the American dream. I learned english when I was 5 years old, and from that young age always felt so proud to be an American.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=5c878a3fa4&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress as a military veteran. I began my journey of service to our nation in 2005 when I joined the U.S. Air Force at the age of 20. During my military service I had the honor of serving my county abroad in the Global War on Terror, serving within the Task Force Medical and the Bagram Theater Internment Facility (BTIF) in Bagram, Afghanistan, during Operation Enduring Freedom in 2007. I know what sacrifice looks like - and this is why I love my country so much.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=a7bd2307c5&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for my kids, your kids, and your grandkids. Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=700c67cc6c&e=0a12281e0e)
[**I’M RUNNING FOR CONGRESS BECAUSE WE HAVE A COUNTRY TO SAVE!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=5ac8a2d90e&e=0a12281e0e)
Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day.
[**I’m running for Congress because America can do better with leaders that will always fight for America first. No matter what.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=a3fc3ca485&e=0a12281e0e)
**As a military veteran** , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation.
**As a medical logistician** , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything.
**As a** **mother** , I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families.
I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before.
[**And i’ll do it again as your next Congresswoman.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=8eb7a2e6b5&e=0a12281e0e)
As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future.
But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country.
[**Will you chip in today to help me win this fight for our nation’s future?**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=c2477f02a5&e=0a12281e0e)
Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again.
Sincerely,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=f5fa9a9f80&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for CongressMaryland’s 6th District
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=7e6e38effc&e=0a12281e0e)

Peter,

1. The anti-Palestinian lobby, including AIPAC and its super PACs, is
planning on spending $100 million to unseat the Squad from office this
year because of their progressive records and calls for a ceasefire in

even convinced some Republicans in Jamaal Bowman’s district to switch
parties just to vote against him in the June primary.

Today's Substack offers a glimpse into the world of campaigning and what all goes down in a competitive U.S. Senate race like ours.
First, TV ads. If you're in California, hopefully you've seen them! We've run multiple ads this cycle, with different ads running in different media markets. **Our most recent ad hits back against the attack ads being run against us** , correcting the record and telling voters these ads have been deemed false by independent fact checkers.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/b9e2b768-3a4f-43fe-a8c1-2adf16ea0991?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
These ads can be produced incredibly quickly to respond to baseless attacks like the ones we've unfortunately seen from dark money super PACs throughout this campaign. TV ads--both through traditional cable, and through streaming services like Hulu--are a key way to reach voters. California has several of the country's most expensive media markets, including #2 Los Angeles, making our TV spend decisions especially consequential.
Digital ads like this one are another critical way we reach voters, and they're some of the most cost-effective. **$15 can get our ad in front of 500 voters,** so we're running digital ads across all sorts of platforms, in both English and Spanish.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3b0b7d5d-4dab-491d-bc18-819082295a17?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And finally, in person events are another way we reach voters. Here are a few photos from recent trips to Long Beach and the East Bay!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/81c97f1f-9c4e-4d4d-86c6-a285d2322f16?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Six days out, we're doing everything we can to fight back against lying ads and communicate with undecided voters. In California, it's not just Election Day, it's election month, as all voters are mailed ballots weeks in advance.
Unfortunately, early ballot returns are painting a worrying picture. As the San Francisco Chronicle just reported, **" while there are roughly equal numbers of voters older than 65 and younger than 35 in California, so far 57% of the ballots turned in have been from seniors and only 2% from younger voters."**
We know from polling that I do particularly well with younger voters, while my opponents perform well with older voters. So this trend is worrying.
But all hope is not lost. **The bottom line is that polling from the last three months boils down to this: this race will be incredibly close. We have to do everything we can between now and Election Day.**
**If you 'd like to help us out in these last six days, here's how:**
1. Californians - Vote by March 5th! Find all the info you need at [https://katieporter.com/vote/](https://substack.com/redirect/f2713346-e089-4e48-abf9-6258d72dd27c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
2. Remind at least 5 friends to vote.
3. Donate. I know it's easy to wonder if your $5 or $50 makes a difference, but we are literally only this far because of grassroots donations. 99% of our contributions are of $100 or less: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kpsubstackq124&refcode=0228](https://substack.com/redirect/d11eea05-caa2-4b8b-a783-fa5b825454c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Thanks so much for following along,

clean_body: And, what we know about initial returns | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more | | ---|---|--- And, what we know about initial returns | | | Feb 28 | | | | | | | | | | | | Today's Substack offers a glimpse into the world of campaigning and what all goes down in a competitive U.S. Senate race like ours. First, TV ads. If you're in California, hopefully you've seen them! We've run multiple ads this cycle, with different ads running in different media markets. Our most recent ad hits back against the attack ads being run against us , correcting the record and telling voters these ads have been deemed false by independent fact checkers. These ads can be produced incredibly quickly to respond to baseless attacks like the ones we've unfortunately seen from dark money super PACs throughout this campaign. TV ads--both through traditional cable, and through streaming services like Hulu--are a key way to reach voters. California has several of the country's most expensive media markets, including #2 Los Angeles, making our TV spend decisions especially consequential. Digital ads like this one are another critical way we reach voters, and they're some of the most cost-effective. $15 can get our ad in front of 500 voters, so we're running digital ads across all sorts of platforms, in both English and Spanish. | | ---|---|--- And finally, in person events are another way we reach voters. Here are a few photos from recent trips to Long Beach and the East Bay! | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- Six days out, we're doing everything we can to fight back against lying ads and communicate with undecided voters. In California, it's not just Election Day, it's election month, as all voters are mailed ballots weeks in advance. Unfortunately, early ballot returns are painting a worrying picture. As the San Francisco Chronicle just reported, " while there are roughly equal numbers of voters older than 65 and younger than 35 in California, so far 57% of the ballots turned in have been from seniors and only 2% from younger voters." We know from polling that I do particularly well with younger voters, while my opponents perform well with older voters. So this trend is worrying. But all hope is not lost. The bottom line is that polling from the last three months boils down to this: this race will be incredibly close. We have to do everything we can between now and Election Day. If you 'd like to help us out in these last six days, here's how:** 1. Californians - Vote by March 5th! Find all the info you need at 2. Remind at least 5 friends to vote. 3. Donate. I know it's easy to wonder if your $5 or $50 makes a difference, but we are literally only this far because of grassroots donations. 99% of our contributions are of $100 or less: Thanks so much for following along, Katie Porter | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | (C) 2024 Katie Porter Katie Porter for Senate, PO Box 5176 Irvine, CA 92616, Email us: info@katieporter.com ? ?

| Dear Friend,

It's been quite a month!

Last week we officially qualified to be on the 2024 Republican Ballot for Congress.

This is a testament to the hundreds of supporters on my team from across the 7th Congressional District. I cannot begin to express my gratitude to each and everyone of you.

As we move forward with our campaign to defeat Susan Wild and to Keep America Free, I am laser-focused on fighting for the issues that matter to Lehigh Valley families like improving our economy, securing our borders, strengthening our military, supporting our veterans and defending our freedoms.

I decided to run for Congress, not because I thought it would be cool or that it was my lifelong dream, I decided to run because I could no longer sit back and watch liberals like Susan Wild and Joe Biden destroy our country.

I am committed to defeating the Wild-Biden agenda, but I cannot do it alone.

---
| |
---
| | Hey folks,

We are less than a week out from the Primary Election on March 5, and rest assured: every single vote will make the difference. Orange County is no stranger to close election calls.

We've got plenty of opportunities to help out this week, which we will communicate below. But if you can't make it to one of these, and still want to help get out the vote, please be in touch! We are happy to get you onboarded any time at all--reach out directly to dan@davemin.com.

First things first, we are rallying with Attorney General Rob Bonta this Saturday at 9AM in Costa Mesa, and we'd love to have you come out and help us knock some doors in the final weekend of the primary campaign! Register for the event using the button below.

---
|
---
|
---
| [Join us this Saturday!](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=0d971c26bd&e=7017cc100e "Join us this Saturday!")
---
|
Let's say you don't want to go door to door...

That's just fine! You can get out the vote from the comfort of your home tomorrow evening (or any time you're free--just reach out!) by using the button below to sign up.

Don't worry if you've never phone banked before! It's super quick and easy to learn. We've got phone banks running in English, Chinese, Vietnamese and Korean!

---
|
---
|
---
| [Sign up to phone bank!](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=ec8edef4d2&e=7017cc100e "Sign up to phone bank!")
---
|
Don't miss our election night get together! Register using the button below, and we'll send you the address closer to date. We look forward to seeing you there!

---
|

|

| [Join us on Election Night!](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=46d5d7d93d&e=7017cc100e "Join us on Election Night!")
---
|
If you'd like to get involved, but the above events don't suit, please reach out directly at dan@davemin.com. We'd love to get you looped in!

Thanks so much, and look forward to seeing you soon.

\- Team Min HQ

subject: Never eat almonds, spinach and peanut butter (Here's why)
body:
[View in Web Browser](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8kLtuwjAYhZ_mz0bkHDuOM3iAorC0I0gdjS_EwoE0MW3z9hWUdv0v3_l0zDCmGBZNzYaAPrqZAOJrAm6ZH8x-_zYtq8urXO3qA073JV4IyMvo_y-fkNIPJqb7tNkWTguYKtjC66phbSWZQFX02gRu4XlbMxUCU84oGazlggvlalWbImowCAYoQMhalZV31tr62CgZGERLgj2CyjB5n_t4OfvJmZiW0l6HIuk-53F-iHWE7uqO5eVmk7_Nv1_2OhC6pzKh-yR032fkzfogP87Eu0cJfNvu3vNJOBSTduNXTCnOsiHBTn-UnwAAAP__XT9fMQ)

If you've been led to believe that peanut butter, almonds and spinach are good for you, today's email might shock you and is important to read, because these 3 healthy foods could be contributing to health problems in your body.

Let's take a quick look at why...

**1\. Peanut butter**

While peanut butter does contain a small amount of protein and vitamins/minerals, the cons outweigh the pros on this food.

First of all, peanuts contain one of the highest concentrations of aflatoxin, which is a mold toxin that is created in peanuts due to storage in moist conditions.

Peanut butter is also very high in inflammatory omega-6 fats and due to the processing of peanut butter, those omega 6 fats are in a harmful oxidized state.

Most people already get too much omega 6 fats from vegetable oils (soy, corn, canola, etc), and this contributes to insulin resistance, heart disease, brain inflammation, cancer, and lots more health problems, since most people are currently eating 5-10x more omega-6 fats than we should be eating in a healthy diet.

Lastly, peanut butter also contains medium amounts of oxalates, which are plant-based antinutrients that when consumed in excess can contribute to kidney stones, thyroid and gut problems, joint problems and more.

We'll talk more about oxalates in the next food...

**2\. Spinach**

Spinach is promoted as a healthy green, but contains FAR more downsides than good sides. Spinach is one of the highest oxalate foods that's commonly eaten by modern humans (in addition to beet greens, beets, almonds, and other veggies and nuts).

The amount of oxalates in a serving of spinach is extremely high, up to 600 mg in a normal sized bowl.

The "safe" amount of oxalates in a daily diet according to world renowned oxalate expert Sally Norton should be between 100-200 mg per day total to avoid a lot of the health problems caused by high oxalate plants.

So, you can see how concerning spinach is with the extremely high oxalate levels.

As mentioned above, eating too much oxalates too frequently can cause serious issues such as kidney stones, thyroid problems, gut damage, skin issues, and joint pain.

In fact, some people have even gotten "oxalate poisoning" by eating green smoothies too often and had to go to the ER for kidney failure.

**3\. Almonds**

Although almonds and almond milk are marketed as healthy, they also contain many downsides, including all of the negatives mentioned above about too much omega 6 fats and too much oxalates.

They're probably ok in your diet occasionally, but I personally avoid eating almonds too often because of these issues with excess oxalates and omega 6 fats.

Now let's take a look at a fun little quiz below and a few more foods...

**Bananas vs oranges vs apples... (the #1 WORST fruit for your gut & energy)**
According to the best-selling author and world-renowned heart surgeon, Dr. Steven Gundry, there's one fruit people over 40 should never eat.

This fruit can **damage your gut and disrupt your hormones**. Both sapping you of energy and **forcing your body to create "sticky" fat cells that can NOT be "burned off" with normal diet and exercise. **

Do you know the fruit I'm talking about? Make sure you do by clicking the one below you think it is, and get the answer from Dr. Gundry himself on the next page:

clean_body: | | | Hi Peter, Today, the League of Conservation Voters (LCV) released the 2023 National Environmental Scorecard. The 2023 Scorecard shows the stark contrast between pro-environmental members and extreme Republicans in Congress. This year, many in our state’s delegation worked to fight back against attacks on our democracy and environmental protections, unleashed by a Republican-led House catering to Big Polluters and the most extreme wing of their party. This was a dramatic change from 2022, when climate champions led both the House and Senate and passed the most significant climate and clean energy investments in American history. In 2023, some in our state’s delegation supported legislation that benefits people and the planet, while some, unfortunately, actively worked against it. This type of Congressional gridlock was one of the least productive Congresses ever. Both of Oregon’s U.S. Senators, Ron Wyden and Jeff Merkley received perfect 100% scores, proving once again that they are climate and environmental champions. and sharing our post on , , or ! Three of Oregon’s U.S. Representatives received perfect 100% scores: Reps. Bonamici, Hoyle, and Salinas! And our all-star climate champ Rep. Blumenauer will retire after this term with a 95% lifetime score! On the other hand, Rep. Bentz received a whopping 0% (yikes), and Rep. Chavez-Deremer received a disappointing 31%. And don't forget to share our post on, , and ! . And join us in thanking Oregon’s climate leaders who helped make 2023 a big year for national climate action! Thank you for all you do! Children slaughtered in school.

Text CEASEFIRE to 30403 to call on your representative to demand and support a ceasefire in Gaza, if they haven't already. | | |
**[Use our tracker to check if your representative has joined the call for a ceasefire in Gaza.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMYd6eLP33O2GRZpvuK-wGuRT_cgYZouVsV-3gDnCkrQaiU9gHAAI5v4U9sZi9tQPMbQ3pnA4RH0sOA-qc5rVxglkp16Q0VBYIqZIGdhwn5zX6OVgkeuIUE_n8gpc6tA404Y1xIwX4r_4nx3OG8eJVLNeHfYyRCDrDLSBADHvr6XvDZzgk_7SK7FTQhFksC--xOcT0Zf01N92J_AYhvZHgL8Ud6slloloAEeo3ArclrV1/448/y25iULAeTdaUw-zi6_92xA/h0/h001.8KQHFQV0KNj7b-O4TRl6QtFobl5YfFDE9H37F5Tqeb4)** If they haven't, call them by texting **CEASEFIRE** to **30403** **[Check our Ceasefire Tracker »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMYd6eLP33O2GRZpvuK-wGuRT_cgYZouVsV-3gDnCkrQaiU9gHAAI5v4U9sZi9tQPMbQ3pnA4RH0sOA-qc5rVxglkp16Q0VBYIqZIGdhwn5zXRuqRyCrDjJLNS3ZC2zXK88d2sqLPK4tte3GJschJQKTzXDvhJiK-upFgTIbuidFozmeDnht3dbkZ3ahZMoZkfutEPX7BrPqXIpzw5_SaQdJ2NKWUCPi4eHErwgf9SEAI/448/y25iULAeTdaUw-zi6_92xA/h1/h001.UQI1SDaobqoq3HZN7vbxB2s_ed2zKAYe6X-0O_0bo0A)** Peter,
There are moments that call for all of us to raise our voices for peace and justice. We're in just such a moment right now, as the people of Gaza, particularly in Rafah, face an unprecedented crisis. Over the past four months, Israel has waged a campaign of collective retribution against the people of Gaza. Many across the world reacted with horror and outrage after Hamas attacked Israel on October 7. But since then, the IDF has killed nearly 30,000 Palestinians, most of them civilians, and displaced millions more. Most of these refugees — more than one million — have fled to the city of Rafah. This isn't just a number: it's families, children, the elderly, all crammed into makeshift shelters with little hope for safety. **And there's nowhere else for them to run.** Now, Prime Minister Netanyahu says that Israel will invade this last refuge for Palestinians in Gaza as soon as March. This would not only escalate what's already a humanitarian catastrophe — it has the potential to spark a broader regional war, drawing in forces around the region. Silence is not an option. The Working Families Party, alongside allies and peace and justice-loving people worldwide, is renewing the call for an immediate ceasefire in Gaza. **We urge the Biden Administration, Congress, international bodies, and leaders around the globe to take decisive action to end this destruction.** Peter, if you’re with us — text **CEASEFIRE** to **30403** to be connected via phone to your representative’s office to demand that they condemn any invasion of Rafah, and call for a ceasefire in Gaza, if they haven't already. [](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMYd6eLP33O2GRZpvuK-wGuRT_cgYZouVsV-3gDnCkrQaiU9gHAAI5v4U9sZi9tQPMbQ3pnA4RH0sOA-qc5rVxglkp16Q0VBYIqZIGdhwn5zXCTWpAjoo2EKCMuGimUr66t71PzLcP6qEgeAMauogl3k5WMuzh3nREeQhBzO49WS7LplqKNOF0ZIAVfzzNNGwSj_VvuQVwBiD5AKrCNAQFOsSOlvCIu8wBT-jBK0cwwtH/448/y25iULAeTdaUw-zi6_92xA/h2/h001.B39Nno5WEfJAQD_c5NScpyJ-SbT9WoCbBZmLxPFrib4) **[To check if your representative has signed onto the call for a ceasefire, use our tracker here.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMYd6eLP33O2GRZpvuK-wGuRT_cgYZouVsV-3gDnCkrQaiU9gHAAI5v4U9sZi9tQPMbQ3pnA4RH0sOA-qc5rVxglkp16Q0VBYIqZIGdhwn5zX0jq-pZYAFUycvg_C5PU9aVKPGycZ2lkA8qgwM32lUHkjzw5i2b-Knl1mRaqpqhVFYP-n_GDYsEv-NUQEGrVI16CGh_9N4pkr8O2jUOxSp9orA4VvJ8yBxSThTFVYS5Cn/448/y25iULAeTdaUw-zi6_92xA/h3/h001.3LH5ZDsBaI-2jNI4FV4RzmFrFKMWvGWRSjyqxxYsrcA)** **[Check our Ceasefire Tracker »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMYd6eLP33O2GRZpvuK-wGuRT_cgYZouVsV-3gDnCkrQaiU9gHAAI5v4U9sZi9tQPMbQ3pnA4RH0sOA-qc5rVxglkp16Q0VBYIqZIGdhwn5zXA5zeXwAcsXScGxiV11MpCeg-6EogbRrteiO8co-1ILTXlS0KfdQh_EIK5To5o0EFjPIl76oW9XUowoqjqSgHbilUifw_JO5B_qTMTkkHV9s2sGZuYLQ6WuH60cFSkwrV/448/y25iULAeTdaUw-zi6_92xA/h4/h001.zcOaeFOZsoo-4eEjnpLdaw99hHgHJHGJpSOReKkAkS8)** This is about more than geopolitics: it's about our collective moral compass, our commitment to human rights, and our shared responsibility to save as many innocent lives as possible. An invasion of Rafah would do nothing to return the remaining hostages held by Hamas, or to bring lasting security to the region. In fact, it could derail any hope for a lasting peace. To elected leaders and everyday people across lines of race, faith, or nation: now is the time to unite for peace. If you haven’t joined this growing movement yet, this is the moment. **Nearly seventy Members of Congress and U.S. Senators have called for a ceasefire so far, but we need more.** Imagine if it were your family, your children, in Rafah right now. clean_body: Text CEASEFIRE to 30403 to call on your representative to demand and support a ceasefire in Gaza, if they haven't already. | | | If they haven't, call them by texting CEASEFIRE to 30403 Peter, There are moments that call for all of us to raise our voices for peace and justice. We're in just such a moment right now, as the people of Gaza, particularly in Rafah, face an unprecedented crisis. Over the past four months, Israel has waged a campaign of collective retribution against the people of Gaza. Many across the world reacted with horror and outrage after Hamas attacked Israel on October 7. But since then, the IDF has killed nearly 30,000 Palestinians, most of them civilians, and displaced millions more. Most of these refugees — more than one million — have fled to the city of Rafah. This isn't just a number: it's families, children, the elderly, all crammed into makeshift shelters with little hope for safety. And there's nowhere else for them to run. Now, Prime Minister Netanyahu says that Israel will invade this last refuge for Palestinians in Gaza as soon as March. This would not only escalate what's already a humanitarian catastrophe — it has the potential to spark a broader regional war, drawing in forces around the region. Silence is not an option. The Working Families Party, alongside allies and peace and justice-loving people worldwide, is renewing the call for an immediate ceasefire in Gaza. We urge the Biden Administration, Congress, international bodies, and leaders around the globe to take decisive action to end this destruction. Peter, if you’re with us — text CEASEFIRE to 30403 to be connected via phone to your representative’s office to demand that they condemn any invasion of Rafah, and call for a ceasefire in Gaza, if they haven't already. This is about more than geopolitics: it's about our collective moral compass, our commitment to human rights, and our shared responsibility to save as many innocent lives as possible. An invasion of Rafah would do nothing to return the remaining hostages held by Hamas, or to bring lasting security to the region. In fact, it could derail any hope for a lasting peace. To elected leaders and everyday people across lines of race, faith, or nation: now is the time to unite for peace. If you haven’t joined this growing movement yet, this is the moment. Nearly seventy Members of Congress and U.S. Senators have called for a ceasefire so far, but we need more. Imagine if it were your family, your children, in Rafah right now. The fear, the uncertainty, the desperation — they're all too real for millions. This isn't about distant politics. It's about human lives. Your voice can make a difference. Dear Peter,
I recently visited the home of Malcolm X in Queens, New York, which was firebombed a week before his assassination on February 21st, 1965.
Along with my uncle, my father, and Martin Luther King, it was one of four assassinations of the 1960s that devastated the soul of our nation.
Malcolm’s death was especially tragic because it came at a moment where the arc of his life had swung toward viewing all people as part of the brotherhood of humanity.
The central revelation that transformed him was a trip to Mecca where he saw people of every race, creed and color worshiping in the same places and praying to the same god.
After that, he saw his life’s mission as being a truth teller:
_“I’m speaking now from what I think, from what I have seen, from what I have analyzed and the conclusions that I have reached. It is not a case of being good or bad blacks and whites, it’s the case of being good or bad human beings.”_
---
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=malcom_x_2_28_24_nd3&n=5)
---
Malcolm came to believe it was his purpose to unite people across racial lines to challenge the power of oppression and injustice in America. _I want to invoke his example today at a time of renewed hatred, polarization and division_.
It’s been the purpose of my campaign, to put aside the divisions and solve the real problems that afflict Americans of all skin colors.
If you want a President who sees the future in our mutual values and the shared interests in achieving a common destiny of greatness for our country, [please support my campaign today.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=malcom_x_2_28_24_nd3&n=6)

body:
Friends,

It's go time! The election is _5 days away_. We have 5 days to get to as many voters as possible and to let them know that Laura is our choice of Congress!

We have a packed GOTV (Get Out The Vote) schedule, please sign up using our link below, I've also put the schedule in this email. **We will be canvassing on Saturday, hosting virtual phone banks, and also be opening the Feminist Majority office for in-person phone banking as well!**

We all want to see Laura successful on Tuesday, but the only way we can make that happen is by getting on the phones and knocking doors for her.

If you are part of a group/organization that would like to sponsor any of the upcoming events by helping bring people out, please email Vince Roncone at Vince@LauraForCongress.org

I look forward to seeing you at any of our campaign events this week and weekend!

[**CLICK HERE SIGN UP TO VOLUNTEER FOR LAURA**](https://www.lauraforcongress.org/volunteer)

Best,
Blake Dellinger

Join me in building a more joyful future

[|

| | Dear Friend, This past Sunday, I had the opportunity to join Oakland’s Black Joy Parade. From the vibrant colors and rhythms of the festival to the shared laughter and food from delicious vendors, every moment of that wonderful day was a testament to the beauty and resilience of Black culture in the East Bay. It was an honor to witness the diversity and creativity of our community on full display and remind us of the history of Black activism, art, and leadership that’s so deeply rooted in the East Bay. [](http://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/A95hkCSpmsVwqX7XcTFAow~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRnwkLaP0REaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2xzLWVtYWlsP3JlZmNvZGVObXJvQm1pZD0xMTI5MjYyMTdXA3NwY0IKZdv7vd9lYL3j8FIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAABE~) | | [Contribute today](http://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/UuSIXzSGFyIzIzUUAOz0SA~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRnwkLaP0SSaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2xzLWVtYWlsP2VtYWlsPWRwd2lsbGlzNjclNDBnbWFpbC5jb20mZmlyc3RuYW1lPUZyaWVuZCZsYXN0bmFtZT1kcHdpbGxpczY3JTQwZ21haWwuY29tJnJlZmNvZGVObXJvQm1pZD0xMTI5MjYyMTdXA3NwY0IKZdv7vd9lYL3j8FIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAABE~)
---
Events like the Black Joy Parade are more than just celebrations; they remind us of the importance of honoring our history, embracing the present moment, and remaining hopeful for the future. I see this desire every day when I meet people in neighborhoods across our district who tell me they want to know what our politicians are really fighting for, and not against. They want our leaders to honor and invest in their brilliance and optimism, and not just pay attention to their trauma and hardships. I believe we must recognize each other’s full humanity in order to create an ambitious agenda that helps everyone in our community reach their true potential.
I launched my campaign a year ago today and as Black History Month comes to a close, I feel more ready than ever to carry this spirit of intentionality with me and continue the urgent work of creating more safe, just, and equitable communities. [Will you take a moment to join me in building a more joyful future?](http://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/A95hkCSpmsVwqX7XcTFAow~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRnwkLaP0REaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2xzLWVtYWlsP3JlZmNvZGVObXJvQm1pZD0xMTI5MjYyMTdXA3NwY0IKZdv7vd9lYL3j8FIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAABE~)
In love and solidarity,
Lateefah

From the vibrant colors and rhythms of the festival to the shared laughter and food from delicious vendors, every moment of that wonderful day was a testament to the beauty and resilience of Black culture in the East Bay. It was an honor to witness the diversity and creativity of our community on full display and remind us of the history of Black activism, art, and leadership that’s so deeply rooted in the East Bay. ~ | | ~ Events like the Black Joy Parade are more than just celebrations; they remind us of the importance of honoring our history, embracing the present moment, and remaining hopeful for the future. I see this desire every day when I meet people in neighborhoods across our district who tell me they want to know what our politicians are really fighting for, and not against. They want our leaders to honor and invest in their brilliance and optimism, and not just pay attention to their trauma and hardships. I believe we must recognize each other’s full humanity in order to create an ambitious agenda that helps everyone in our community reach their true potential. name: Sherrod Brown
subject: Do you want the good news or the bad news?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Shontel Brown for Congress
body:
**I'll give you the good news first, Peter:** With the latest polls showing me neck and neck with my GOP opponents, we've just launched a brand-new TV ad to spread our pro-worker message to Ohio voters and pull ahead!

**Here's the bad news:** My Trump-backed opponent is fighting back with TV ads of his own – and if we don't raise $100,000 by midnight tomorrow, we may not have the resources we need to keep up.

Ronna Romney-McDaniel Gives Tearful Goodbye, Slams Fellow Republicans During Final RNC Staff Meeting (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/02/ronna-romney-mcdaniel-gives-tearful-goodbye-slams-fellow-republicans-during-final-rnc-staff-meeting.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=ece82f2a16-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

During a Wednesday morning staff meeting, outgoing Republican National Committee Chair Ronna Romney-McDaniel gave a tearful and emotional goodbye – even slamming fellow Republicans in her final address to the organization that she has led for the last seven years.

CLICK TO READ THE FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/02/ronna-romney-mcdaniel-gives-tearful-goodbye-slams-fellow-republicans-during-final-rnc-staff-meeting.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=ece82f2a16-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

“We’ve gone through a lot these past four years or seven years. We had everything against this building, especially people in our own side. And that’s the most unfortunate part about it,” said Romney-McDaniel, the niece of Never Trumper and Utah Republican U.S. Sen. Mitt Romney.

Romney-McDaniel said she was proud of what the RNC team accomplished – under her leadership, over the last seven years.

“I’m so proud of what we’ve done. And I’m holding my head high. All of you should hold your head high. We don’t win elections without a strong RNC and anybody who says otherwise is wrong.”

Under the leadership of Romney-McDaniel, Democrats have dominated at the national level – defeating Republicans in key races in 2018, 2020 and 2022. Conservative attorney and Townhall columnist Kurt Schlichter summarized her chairmanship in a column, writing,

“Five rounds of elections – three cycles and two Georgia primaries – and not a win among them.”

| | Friend, We all know that our elections are supposed to be fair, not just for the voters, but for the candidates too. But in New Jersey, the primary elections are far from fair for the candidates. The state has a “county line,” where candidates who are endorsed by the county party are all grouped together, while everybody else could be in an entirely separate area of the ballot, even if they’re running for the same office! It may not seem like a huge deal, but what if we told you that being on the county line may give someone a greater advantage in winning their election? This unfair ballot design is just another way to keep power in the hands of a select few at the expense of the _true_ will of the voters. Voters should have the power to determine the outcome of an election, not the county party. **[New Jersey’s county line is just another way to keep power in the hands of the select few at the expense of both the candidates and the will of the people. Elections need to be free and fair, and the county line is standing in the way of it. If you chip in $10 now, we can work together to support free and fair elections throughout the country, including in New Jersey.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79949323/457967987/444630146?refcode=2-28-24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ2ZmFkYzczLTkwZDYtZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=hq6bOTZZpG2PZ09D3ptAx0eu1oUUj-w5WUbQE47GJzw=)** Listen, the design of these ballots is intentional. County parties in New Jersey want to ensure the victory of their candidates by any means necessary, but this county line is unfair. Voting should be simple and clear for voters, and the county line makes voting confusing. **[**If you agree that voting should be simple and clear, please contribute $10 today so we can keep working together towards our goal: free and fair elections for all. The county line is just one way that the powerful few keep power for themselves at the expense of the will of the people, and we have to put a stop to it.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79949324/457967988/444630146?refcode=2-28-24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ2ZmFkYzczLTkwZDYtZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=hq6bOTZZpG2PZ09D3ptAx0eu1oUUj-w5WUbQE47GJzw=)** Thank you,— Team ECU/LAV Action

**_"I hope Nancy gets the help she needs. I really do... She’s got a lot of challenges." -FORMER Speaker of the House, Kevin McCarthy_**

This aint my first rodeo, Fellow American.

I’m used to people underestimating me. _Truly!_

I didn’t become the first woman to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets by having a lot of people believe in me.

I didn’t pick myself up after dropping out of high school and go waitress at Waffle House to put food on the table because of handouts.

I didn’t become a strong conservative FIGHTER in Washington DC because I didn’t face challenges.

**_NOPE!_**

I got to where I am because I am a fighter. I’m not afraid to get dirt under my fingernails and sweat on my brow for the things that I believe in. _**And I believe in America.**_ I will fight until the day I die for what is RIGHT in this country – _and I’m not a sell-out to corporate greed like the former Speaker._

Which is why he is coming after me on his revenge tour. I can’t be bought. My vote is not for sale. I work for the American people and the American people ONLY. _Which frankly scares the HECK out of people here in Washington who aren’t used to people they cannot control._

**So, today, I’m taking the former Speaker’s advice:** [**I’m asking for help._Not from lobbyists or party leaders but from the people I work for._ Help from you, Fellow American.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=2b6e3742a03845f08f69708b6c92c0b3&_e=v8_59GzQv7aTgoO3nFFnOS4LMKUkA-Bp2AzL5zTRLZd7SJnYRsA6OGNvZKi9jRDf3gVnpHaH_e7NHloCJJA7TDit7zQ4GEWnEcVkZlrCB_uBL4JboPQRH6xX_8vy29pQ2DGo3iw3JQJ-g2OIZDz7ghE1e1BoOdZ_XWQEdTFWaNG50Bb5gqWuF9GO-RGP-aRtn-Ogmej4eQ8T-_KN_jhXeG5GanneTV7veqnzPdNLAGkZHUCxeGr2kEofBlXUaXxWMbtdtybreENaFW_iha0xgUIr4LbBEODX-_hIG4GCdajnAu9VR9JrNJnY1CkMieum0kOBriIjpbxwoSsMbE2EKM4Gr6uZb_kUQRpDz3GKVbdMeYBhqR6661pFBtuxOVnM)

Michigan has historically been a swing state, and having an early primary means that Michigan sets the tone for the rest of the country. That’s why Trump’s victory last night is so serious. **He’s gaining momentum and is one step closer to clinching the Republican nomination. It’s very likely now that voters will see another match-up between Biden and Trump this November.**

This is one of the most challenging times to serve in elected office – a country rife with political divisions, Congressional dysfunction due to Republican incompetence, and extreme attacks on fundamental constitutional freedoms. These are all problems exacerbated by Trump’s presidency. We can’t allow him to serve another term and lead us further into chaos.

I can’t overstate how critical the Presidential primary results are, and the Trump-Biden contrast could not be clearer.
